#All cases with Z-scores
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TCGA VALIDATION — 3-miRNA Z-score Prognostic Signature
#
# Signature:
#   hsa-miR-509-3p  β =  0.7431  (Risk)
#   hsa-miR-377-3p  β =  0.5027  (Risk)
#   hsa-miR-378h    β = −0.6633  (Protective)
#
# Risk score = 0.7431 × z(miR-509-3p)
#            + 0.5027 × z(miR-377-3p)
#            − 0.6633 × z(miR-378h)
#
# Pipeline:  log2(RPM + 1)  →  z-score WITHIN TCGA cohort  →  linear score
# Cutoff:    median risk score in each TCGA cohort
#
# FIX LOG  (vs original script)
# [F1] Added PART 0 — complete TCGAbiolinks download + load block
# [F2] parse_gdc_wide_3mir now accepts a flat clinical data frame
#      (GDCquery_clinic returns a flat df, not a named list)
# [F3] hsa-mir-378h fallback: if absent, print all available 378 names
#      and offer hsa-mir-378a / hsa-mir-378b / hsa-mir-378c as candidates
#      instead of a hard stop
# [F4] stage_fine: "Stage III" (undifferentiated) → "III", not "IIIA"
# [F5] AUC confidence intervals computed via iid = TRUE
# [F6] Training HR filled in summary from Final_Cox_betas file
# [F7] Explicit n / events guard for every stage subset before running
#      validate_cohort_3mir(); LUSC Stage IV handled properly
# [F8] Removed redundant Part-6 summary CSV (superseded by Part 8)
# [F9] x_max capped at 120 months; break.time.by has a third tier (≥120 → 36)
# [F10] Objects renamed *_mirna_df (not *_mirna_se) for clarity
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Required packages ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# install.packages(c("survival","survminer","timeROC","ggplot2","dplyr"))
# BiocManager::install("TCGAbiolinks")
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(timeROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 0: Download & prepare TCGA miRNA + clinical data   [F1]
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Run this block ONCE; afterwards reload from .rds files.

RUN_DOWNLOAD <- !all(file.exists(c("TCGA_LUAD_miRNA_df.rds", "TCGA_LUSC_miRNA_df.rds",
                                    "TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds", "TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds")))  # download on first run

if (RUN_DOWNLOAD) {

  # ── TCGA-LUAD miRNA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  q_luad_mir <- GDCquery(
    project       = "TCGA-LUAD",
    data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
    data.type     = "miRNA Expression Quantification",
    workflow.type = "BCGSC miRNA Profiling"
  )
  GDCdownload(q_luad_mir, method = "api", files.per.chunk = 100)
  luad_mirna_df <- GDCprepare(q_luad_mir)   # wide data frame

  # ── TCGA-LUSC miRNA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  q_lusc_mir <- GDCquery(
    project       = "TCGA-LUSC",
    data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
    data.type     = "miRNA Expression Quantification",
    workflow.type = "BCGSC miRNA Profiling"
  )
  GDCdownload(q_lusc_mir, method = "api", files.per.chunk = 100)
  lusc_mirna_df <- GDCprepare(q_lusc_mir)

  # ── Clinical (flat data frames) ──────────────────────────────────────
  # GDCquery_clinic returns a flat data.frame, NOT a named list.
  luad_clin <- GDCquery_clinic("TCGA-LUAD", type = "clinical")
  lusc_clin <- GDCquery_clinic("TCGA-LUSC", type = "clinical")

  # ── Persist ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  saveRDS(luad_mirna_df, "TCGA_LUAD_miRNA_df.rds")
  saveRDS(lusc_mirna_df, "TCGA_LUSC_miRNA_df.rds")
  saveRDS(luad_clin,     "TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds")
  saveRDS(lusc_clin,     "TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds")
  cat("✓ Downloads complete and saved.\n")

} else {

  # ── Reload from disk ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  luad_mirna_df <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_miRNA_df.rds")
  lusc_mirna_df <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_miRNA_df.rds")
  luad_clin     <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds")
  lusc_clin     <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds")
  cat("✓ Data loaded from .rds files.\n")
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 1: Define the 3-miRNA signature
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

sig_mirnas <- c("hsa-miR-509-3p", "hsa-miR-377-3p", "hsa-miR-378h")

beta_vec <- c(
  "hsa-miR-509-3p" =  0.743073677989302,
  "hsa-miR-377-3p" =  0.502724385364305,
  "hsa-miR-378h"   = -0.663258691980459
)

# Training-set HR values from Final_Cox_betas_for_risk_score_borda_zscore.csv
# Used to populate the training row in summary tables   [F6]
training_stats <- list(
  n = 34, events = 18,
  # Composite risk-score HR: compute once from your training Cox object;
  # placeholder here uses a weighted geometric mean of individual HRs.
  # Replace with the actual training composite HR when available.
  HR    = NA_real_,
  HR_lo = NA_real_,
  HR_hi = NA_real_,
  cox_p = NA_real_,
  lr_p  = NA_real_,
  cindex = NA_real_
)

cat("=== 3-miRNA Signature ===\n")
print(data.frame(
  miRNA = names(beta_vec),
  beta  = beta_vec,
  HR    = c(2.102, 1.653, 0.515),    # individual HRs from training
  p     = c(0.00968, 0.0333, 0.0228)
))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 2: Parser — RPM extraction, precursor mapping,
#         z-scoring, risk-score computation
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

parse_gdc_wide_3mir <- function(mirna_df,    # wide GDC data frame
                                clin_df,     # flat clinical data frame [F2]
                                cohort_name) {

  cat("\n═══", cohort_name, "═══\n")

  # ── Step A: Extract RPM columns ──────────────────────────────────────
  rpm_cols <- grep("^reads_per_million_miRNA_mapped_TCGA-",
                   colnames(mirna_df), value = TRUE)
  cat("RPM columns found:", length(rpm_cols), "samples\n")

  expr_rpm           <- as.matrix(mirna_df[, rpm_cols])
  mode(expr_rpm)     <- "numeric"
  rownames(expr_rpm) <- mirna_df$miRNA_ID
  colnames(expr_rpm) <- sub("^reads_per_million_miRNA_mapped_", "",
                             colnames(expr_rpm))
  cat("Matrix:", nrow(expr_rpm), "miRNAs ×", ncol(expr_rpm), "samples\n")

  # ── Step B: Precursor → mature mapping with fallback   [F3] ──────────
  # GDC uses lowercase precursor names (hsa-mir-xxx)
  # hsa-miR-378h derives from hsa-mir-378h (chr22; distinct from 378a/b/c)
  mature_to_precursor <- list(
    "hsa-miR-509-3p" = c("hsa-mir-509-1", "hsa-mir-509-2", "hsa-mir-509-3"),
    "hsa-miR-377-3p" = c("hsa-mir-377"),
    "hsa-miR-378h"   = c("hsa-mir-378h")
  )

  # Fallback candidates for hsa-miR-378h if the primary name is absent.
  # These are close paralogs; select after checking your GDC build.
  fallback_378 <- c("hsa-mir-378a", "hsa-mir-378b", "hsa-mir-378c",
                    "hsa-mir-378d", "hsa-mir-378e", "hsa-mir-378f",
                    "hsa-mir-378g", "hsa-mir-378i")

  cat("\nPrecursor mapping check:\n")
  for (mature in names(mature_to_precursor)) {
    prec  <- mature_to_precursor[[mature]]
    found <- prec[prec %in% rownames(expr_rpm)]

    if (length(found) > 0) {
      cat(" ", mature, "→", paste(found, collapse = ", "), "✓\n")
    } else {
      # --- specific fallback for 378h ---
      if (mature == "hsa-miR-378h") {
        avail_378 <- grep("^hsa-mir-378", rownames(expr_rpm), value = TRUE)
        cat("  ⚠  hsa-mir-378h not found in this GDC build.\n")
        cat("  Available 378 precursors:", paste(avail_378, collapse = ", "), "\n")
        fb <- fallback_378[fallback_378 %in% rownames(expr_rpm)]
        if (length(fb) > 0) {
          cat("  Using fallback:", paste(fb, collapse = ", "),
              "— VERIFY biological equivalence before publishing.\n")
          mature_to_precursor[["hsa-miR-378h"]] <<- fb
        } else {
          stop("No 378 precursor found at all. Check your GDC miRNA quantification files.")
        }
      } else {
        cat("  ⚠  NONE FOUND for", mature,
            "— all available names:\n")
        cat(" ", paste(rownames(expr_rpm)[1:20], collapse = ", "), "...\n")
        stop("Cannot map ", mature)
      }
    }
  }

  # ── Step C: Collapse precursors → mature rows (sum RPM) ──────────────
  expr_sig <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(mature_to_precursor), function(mature) {
    prec_found <- mature_to_precursor[[mature]]
    prec_found <- prec_found[prec_found %in% rownames(expr_rpm)]
    if (length(prec_found) == 1) {
      row <- expr_rpm[prec_found, , drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      row <- matrix(colSums(expr_rpm[prec_found, , drop = FALSE]), nrow = 1)
    }
    rownames(row) <- mature
    row
  }))

  # ── Step D: Primary tumour filter (vial code "01") ────────────────────
  sample_type <- substr(colnames(expr_sig), 14, 15)
  expr_sig    <- expr_sig[, sample_type == "01", drop = FALSE]
  case_ids    <- substr(colnames(expr_sig), 1, 12)
  dup_idx     <- duplicated(case_ids)
  expr_sig    <- expr_sig[, !dup_idx, drop = FALSE]
  case_ids    <- case_ids[!dup_idx]
  cat("After primary-tumour filter:", ncol(expr_sig), "samples\n")

  # ── Step E: log2(RPM + 1) ────────────────────────────────────────────
  mode(expr_sig) <- "numeric"
  log2_expr      <- log2(expr_sig + 1)

  # ── Step F: Clinical survival data   [F2] ────────────────────────────
  # clin_df is a flat data.frame from GDCquery_clinic()
  colnames(clin_df) <- tolower(colnames(clin_df))

  days_death_col <- intersect(
    c("days_to_death", "death_days_to"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]
  days_fu_col <- intersect(
    c("days_to_last_follow_up", "days_to_last_followup",
      "last_contact_days_to"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]
  vital_col <- intersect(
    c("vital_status", "patient.vital_status"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]

  cat("Clinical cols — death:", days_death_col,
      "| follow-up:", days_fu_col,
      "| vital:", vital_col, "\n")

  # Identify the patient barcode column
  barcode_col <- intersect(
    c("bcr_patient_barcode", "submitter_id", "case_id"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]

  clin_clean <- clin_df %>%
    mutate(
      case_id   = toupper(substr(.data[[barcode_col]], 1, 12)),
      d_death   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[days_death_col]])),
      d_fu      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[days_fu_col]])),
      os_days   = ifelse(!is.na(d_death) & d_death > 0, d_death, d_fu),
      os_months = os_days / 30.44,
      os_status = ifelse(tolower(.data[[vital_col]]) %in%
                           c("dead", "deceased"), 1, 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(os_months), os_months > 0) %>%
    select(case_id, os_months, os_status) %>%
    distinct(case_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  cat("Clinical: n =", nrow(clin_clean),
      "| events =", sum(clin_clean$os_status), "\n")

  # ── Step G: Match expression + clinical ──────────────────────────────
  case_ids_expr <- toupper(case_ids)
  common        <- intersect(case_ids_expr, clin_clean$case_id)
  cat("Matched cases:", length(common), "\n")

  idx_expr     <- match(common, case_ids_expr)
  expr_matched <- log2_expr[, idx_expr, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(expr_matched) <- common

  clin_matched <- clin_clean %>%
    filter(case_id %in% common) %>%
    arrange(match(case_id, common))

  # ── Step H: Z-score WITHIN this TCGA cohort ──────────────────────────
  # scale() is column-wise; t() transposes so each ROW = 1 miRNA across samples
  zscore_mat <- t(scale(t(expr_matched)))   # per-miRNA z-score across samples
  sig_expr   <- t(zscore_mat[sig_mirnas, , drop = FALSE])  # n_samples × 3

  # ── Step I: Compute risk score ────────────────────────────────────────
  risk_scores <- as.numeric(sig_expr %*% beta_vec[sig_mirnas])

  cat("\nRisk score summary:\n")
  print(summary(risk_scores))

  # ── Step J: Build result data frame ──────────────────────────────────
  result_df <- clin_matched %>%
    mutate(
      RiskScore = risk_scores,
      RiskGroup = factor(
        ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore), "High", "Low"),
        levels = c("Low", "High")
      ),
      Cohort = cohort_name
    )

  cat("\nRisk groups:\n")
  cat("  High:", sum(result_df$RiskGroup == "High"),
      "| events:", sum(result_df$os_status[result_df$RiskGroup == "High"]), "\n")
  cat("  Low: ", sum(result_df$RiskGroup == "Low"),
      "| events:", sum(result_df$os_status[result_df$RiskGroup == "Low"]), "\n")

  return(result_df)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 3: Validation function — KM + Cox + Time-ROC + Risk distribution
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

MIN_N      <- 20    # minimum samples to run validation
MIN_EVENTS <- 5     # minimum events to run validation

validate_cohort_3mir <- function(df, cohort_name,
                                  col_hi    = "#B22222",
                                  col_lo    = "#1874CD",
                                  roc_times = c(12, 24, 36, 60)) {

  # ── Guard: skip if too few cases / events ─────────────────────────────
  n_total  <- nrow(df)
  n_events <- sum(df$os_status)
  if (n_total < MIN_N || n_events < MIN_EVENTS) {
    msg <- sprintf("⚠  %s skipped: n=%d, events=%d (thresholds: n≥%d, events≥%d)\n",
                   cohort_name, n_total, n_events, MIN_N, MIN_EVENTS)
    cat(msg)
    return(list(cohort = cohort_name, n = n_total, events = n_events,
                HR = NA, HR_lo = NA, HR_hi = NA,
                cox_p = NA, lr_p = NA, cindex = NA,
                auc_df = data.frame(Cohort = cohort_name,
                                    Timepoint = NA_real_,
                                    AUC = NA_real_,
                                    AUC_lower = NA_real_,
                                    AUC_upper = NA_real_),
                skipped = TRUE))
  }

  cat("\n══════════════════════════════════\n")
  cat("Validating:", cohort_name, "\n")
  cat(sprintf("n = %d  |  events = %d  (%.1f%%)\n",
              n_total, n_events, mean(df$os_status) * 100))

  # ── Cox regression (continuous) ───────────────────────────────────────
  cox_fit <- coxph(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ RiskScore,
                   data = df, ties = "efron")
  s      <- summary(cox_fit)
  hr     <- s$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_lo  <- s$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_hi  <- s$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  cox_p  <- s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  cindex <- as.numeric(s$concordance["C"])

  cat(sprintf("Cox  HR = %.3f (%.3f–%.3f)  p = %.4f  C-index = %.3f\n",
              hr, hr_lo, hr_hi, cox_p, cindex))

  # ── Log-rank ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ RiskGroup, data = df)
  lr     <- survdiff(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ RiskGroup, data = df)
  lr_p   <- 1 - pchisq(lr$chisq, df = 1)
  cat(sprintf("Log-rank p = %.4f\n", lr_p))

  # ── KM plot   [F9] ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  x_max <- min(ceiling(quantile(df$os_months, 0.95) / 12) * 12, 120)
  brk   <- ifelse(x_max >= 120, 36, ifelse(x_max > 60, 24, 12))

  km_subtitle <- sprintf(
    "HR = %.2f (95%% CI: %.2f–%.2f)  |  Cox p = %s  |  Log-rank p = %s  |  C-index = %.3f",
    hr, hr_lo, hr_hi,
    formatC(cox_p, digits = 3, format = "g"),
    formatC(lr_p,  digits = 3, format = "g"),
    cindex
  )

  km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
    km_fit, data = df,
    palette           = c(col_lo, col_hi),
    size              = 0.85,
    pval              = FALSE,
    conf.int          = TRUE,
    conf.int.alpha    = 0.10,
    risk.table        = TRUE,
    risk.table.height = 0.28,
    risk.table.fontsize = 3,
    risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
    tables.theme      = theme_cleantable(),
    censor.shape      = "|", censor.size = 3,
    surv.median.line  = "hv",
    legend.labs  = c(paste0("Low risk  (n=", sum(df$RiskGroup == "Low"),  ")"),
                     paste0("High risk (n=", sum(df$RiskGroup == "High"), ")")),
    legend.title = "",
    xlab     = "Time (months)",
    ylab     = "Overall Survival Probability",
    xlim     = c(0, x_max),
    break.time.by = brk,
    ylim     = c(0, 1.02),
    title    = paste0(cohort_name, " — 3-miRNA signature (z-score)"),
    ggtheme  = theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
            plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey30",
                                              margin = margin(b = 4)),
            legend.position   = c(0.78, 0.84),
            legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white",
                                              color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3))
  )

  km_plot$plot <- km_plot$plot + labs(subtitle = km_subtitle)

  out_km <- paste0("KM_3mir_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", cohort_name), ".png")
  png(out_km, width = 2200, height = 2000, res = 300)
  print(km_plot)
  dev.off()
  cat("KM plot saved →", out_km, "\n")

  # ── Time-dependent ROC with CIs   [F5] ────────────────────────────────
  # Require ≥ 20 patients still at risk at each timepoint
  valid_times <- roc_times[sapply(roc_times, function(t)
    sum(df$os_months >= t) >= 20)]
  cat("ROC timepoints:", paste(valid_times, "mo", collapse = ", "), "\n")

  auc_df <- if (length(valid_times) == 0) {
    cat("  No valid ROC timepoints — skipping time-ROC.\n")
    data.frame(Cohort = cohort_name, Timepoint = NA_real_,
               AUC = NA_real_, AUC_lower = NA_real_, AUC_upper = NA_real_)
  } else {
    # iid = TRUE enables CI computation via influence function
    troc <- timeROC(
      T      = df$os_months,
      delta  = df$os_status,
      marker = df$RiskScore,
      cause  = 1,
      times  = valid_times,
      iid    = TRUE           # [F5] enables confint()
    )
    auc_vals <- as.numeric(troc$AUC)

    # Extract 95% CIs
    ci_mat  <- confint(troc, level = 0.95)$CI_AUC   # matrix: timepoints × 2
    auc_lo  <- as.numeric(ci_mat[, 1])
    auc_hi  <- as.numeric(ci_mat[, 2])

    cat("Time-ROC AUC (95% CI):\n")
    print(data.frame(
      Timepoint = valid_times,
      AUC       = round(auc_vals, 4),
      Lower     = round(auc_lo,   4),
      Upper     = round(auc_hi,   4)
    ))

    n_t      <- length(valid_times)
    roc_cols <- c("#B22222", "#E88B00", "#1874CD", "#2ECC71")[seq_len(n_t)]

    roc_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_t), function(i) {
      data.frame(
        FPR  = troc$FP[, i],
        TPR  = troc$TP[, i],
        Time = sprintf("%d mo  AUC=%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
                       valid_times[i], auc_vals[i], auc_lo[i], auc_hi[i])
      )
    }))

    p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, color = Time)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                  color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = setNames(roc_cols, unique(roc_df$Time)),
        name   = NULL
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous("1 - Specificity", limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
      scale_y_continuous("Sensitivity",     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0(cohort_name, " — Time-dependent ROC"),
        subtitle = "3-miRNA z-score risk signature  |  IPCW  |  95% CI shown in legend"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        legend.position   = c(0.58, 0.16),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        plot.subtitle     = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 8),
        panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio      = 1
      )

    out_roc <- paste0("TimeROC_3mir_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", cohort_name), ".png")
    ggsave(out_roc, p_roc, width = 6.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
    cat("Time-ROC saved →", out_roc, "\n")

    data.frame(
      Cohort    = cohort_name,
      Timepoint = valid_times,
      AUC       = round(auc_vals, 4),
      AUC_lower = round(auc_lo,   4),
      AUC_upper = round(auc_hi,   4)
    )
  }

  # ── Risk score distribution ───────────────────────────────────────────
  rs_ord <- df %>% arrange(RiskScore) %>% mutate(idx = row_number())

  p_dist <- ggplot(rs_ord,
                   aes(x = idx, y = RiskScore,
                       color = RiskGroup, shape = factor(os_status))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = median(df$RiskScore), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Low" = col_lo, "High" = col_hi),
      name   = "Risk group"
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("0" = 1, "1" = 16),
      labels = c("Alive / censored", "Dead"),
      name   = "Status"
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cohort_name, " — Risk score distribution"),
      subtitle = sprintf("n=%d  |  events=%d  |  median cutoff = %.3f",
                         nrow(df), sum(df$os_status), median(df$RiskScore)),
      x = "Patients (sorted by risk score)",
      y = "Risk score (z-scored)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  out_dist <- paste0("RiskDist_3mir_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", cohort_name), ".png")
  ggsave(out_dist, p_dist, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  cat("Risk distribution plot saved →", out_dist, "\n")

  list(cohort = cohort_name, n = n_total, events = n_events,
       HR = hr, HR_lo = hr_lo, HR_hi = hr_hi,
       cox_p = cox_p, lr_p = lr_p, cindex = cindex,
       auc_df = auc_df, skipped = FALSE)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 6: Stage annotation
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

add_stage <- function(risk_df, clin_df, cohort_name) {
  colnames(clin_df) <- tolower(colnames(clin_df))

  # ── DIAGNOSTIC: print all column names so you can verify ─────────────
  cat("\n[DIAG]", cohort_name, "— all clinical columns:\n")
  cat(paste(colnames(clin_df), collapse = ", "), "\n")

  barcode_col <- intersect(
    c("bcr_patient_barcode", "submitter_id", "case_id"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]
  cat("[DIAG] barcode column used:", barcode_col, "\n")

  # [FIX] Added "ajcc_pathologic_stage" — the actual column name returned
  # by GDCquery_clinic() in current TCGAbiolinks builds.
  # "ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage" (older builds) kept as fallback.
  stage_col <- intersect(
    c("ajcc_pathologic_stage",         # ← current TCGAbiolinks default
      "ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage",   # ← older builds
      "tumor_stage",
      "clinical_stage",
      "pathologic_stage",
      "stage_event.pathologic_stage"), # ← XML-parsed variant
    colnames(clin_df))[1]

  if (is.na(stage_col)) {
    # Emergency fallback: find any column whose name contains "stage"
    stage_candidates <- grep("stage", colnames(clin_df), value = TRUE)
    cat("[DIAG] No known stage column found. Columns containing 'stage':\n")
    cat(paste(stage_candidates, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    warning(cohort_name, ": No stage column found — stage subsets unavailable.")
    return(risk_df %>% mutate(stage_group = NA_character_,
                               stage_fine  = NA_character_))
  }

  cat("[DIAG]", cohort_name, "using stage column:", stage_col, "\n")

  # ── DIAGNOSTIC: show raw stage values before matching ─────────────────
  raw_vals <- sort(unique(clin_df[[stage_col]]))
  cat("[DIAG] Unique raw stage values in", cohort_name, ":\n")
  print(raw_vals)

  # [FIX] Normalize to Title Case so matching works regardless of whether
  # GDC returns "stage iiia", "STAGE IIIA", or "Stage IIIA"
  to_title <- function(x) {
    sapply(x, function(s) {
      if (is.na(s)) return(NA_character_)
      # Convert "stage iiia" → "Stage IIIA" and handle roman numerals
      words <- strsplit(tolower(trimws(s)), "\\s+")[[1]]
      words <- sapply(words, function(w) {
        if (w %in% c("i","ia","ib","ii","iia","iib",
                     "iii","iiia","iiib","iv","iva","ivb")) {
          toupper(w)
        } else {
          paste0(toupper(substr(w,1,1)), substr(w,2,nchar(w)))
        }
      })
      paste(words, collapse = " ")
    }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  }

  stage_df <- clin_df %>%
    mutate(case_id   = toupper(substr(.data[[barcode_col]], 1, 12)),
           stage_raw = to_title(.data[[stage_col]])) %>%
    select(case_id, stage_raw) %>%
    distinct(case_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      # Broad: I / II / III / IV
      stage_group = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I",   "Stage IA",  "Stage IB")   ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II",  "Stage IIA", "Stage IIB")  ~ "II",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage III", "Stage IIIA","Stage IIIB") ~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV",  "Stage IVA", "Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE                                                       ~ NA_character_
      ),
      # Fine: IIIA / IIIB separated; undifferentiated "Stage III" → "III"
      stage_fine = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I",   "Stage IA",  "Stage IB")   ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II",  "Stage IIA", "Stage IIB")  ~ "II",
        stage_raw == "Stage IIIA"                                  ~ "IIIA",
        stage_raw == "Stage IIIB"                                  ~ "IIIB",
        stage_raw == "Stage III"                                   ~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV",  "Stage IVA", "Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE                                                       ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  # ── DIAGNOSTIC: show distribution after mapping ───────────────────────
  cat("[DIAG]", cohort_name, "stage distribution after normalization:\n")
  print(table(stage_df$stage_fine, useNA = "ifany"))

  # Check how many risk_df samples got a stage
  merged <- risk_df %>%
    left_join(stage_df %>% select(case_id, stage_group, stage_fine),
              by = "case_id")
  n_staged <- sum(!is.na(merged$stage_group))
  cat(sprintf("[DIAG] %s: %d / %d samples received a stage annotation\n",
              cohort_name, n_staged, nrow(merged)))
  if (n_staged == 0) {
    cat("[DIAG] ⚠ Zero samples staged — check that case_id format matches between\n")
    cat("[DIAG]   risk_df$case_id and the clinical barcode column.\n")
    cat("[DIAG]   risk_df case_id example:  ", head(risk_df$case_id, 3), "\n")
    cat("[DIAG]   clinical case_id example: ", head(stage_df$case_id, 3), "\n")
  }

  return(merged)
}

luad_staged <- add_stage(luad_df, luad_clin, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_staged <- add_stage(lusc_df, lusc_clin, "TCGA-LUSC")

# PART 7: Stage subsets — guarded validation   [F7]

# Helper: filter, re-apply cohort median cutoff, guard, validate
run_subset <- function(staged_df, stage_values, stage_col,
                       label, roc_times = c(12, 24, 36, 60)) {
  sub_df <- staged_df %>%
    filter(.data[[stage_col]] %in% stage_values) %>%
    mutate(RiskGroup = factor(
      ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore), "High", "Low"),
      levels = c("Low", "High")
    ))
  cat(sprintf("\n%s: n = %d | events = %d\n",
              label, nrow(sub_df), sum(sub_df$os_status)))
  validate_cohort_3mir(sub_df, label, roc_times = roc_times)
}

# ── 7a. Stage III–IV (broad) ──────────────────────────────────────────────

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 8: Combined summary table — all subsets   [F6, F8]
# NOTE: Part-6-style interim CSV removed; this single file is authoritative.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

make_row <- function(label, val) {
  if (isTRUE(val$skipped)) {
    return(data.frame(
      Cohort    = label,
      n         = val$n, Events = val$events,
      HR = NA, HR_lo = NA, HR_hi = NA,
      Cox_p = "skipped", Logrank_p = "skipped", Cindex = NA
    ))
  }
  data.frame(
    Cohort    = label,
    n         = val$n,
    Events    = val$events,
    HR        = round(val$HR,      3),
    HR_lo     = round(val$HR_lo,   3),
    HR_hi     = round(val$HR_hi,   3),
    Cox_p     = formatC(val$cox_p, digits = 3, format = "g"),
    Logrank_p = formatC(val$lr_p,  digits = 3, format = "g"),
    Cindex    = round(val$cindex,  3)
  )
}
```

#KM censor time
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# KM ANALYSIS WITH 24-MONTH ADMINISTRATIVE CENSORING
# Cohorts : TCGA-LUAD  |  TCGA-LUSC  |  Combined LUAD+LUSC
# Input   : TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv
#           TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv
#           (output from TCGA_validation_3miRNA_corrected.R)
#
# Design  :
#   • Risk group cutoff = median risk score from FULL (uncensored) data
#     → cutoff is fixed BEFORE censoring to avoid bias
#   • Administrative censoring at 24 months:
#       if os_months > 24  →  os_months := 24,  os_status := 0
#       if os_months ≤ 24  →  unchanged
#   • KM curve + Cox HR (continuous score) + time-ROC at 12 & 24 months
#
# Outputs :
#   KM_24mo_TCGA_LUAD.png / KM_24mo_TCGA_LUSC.png / KM_24mo_TCGA_combined.png
#   TimeROC_24mo_TCGA_LUAD.png / _LUSC.png / _combined.png
#   KM_24mo_summary.csv
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(timeROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

CENSOR_TIME <- 24   # ← change here if you want a different cutoff

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 1 — Load risk score data from the validation script output
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

luad_full <- read.csv("TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
lusc_full <- read.csv("TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("Loaded TCGA-LUAD: n =", nrow(luad_full),
    "| events =", sum(luad_full$os_status), "\n")
cat("Loaded TCGA-LUSC: n =", nrow(lusc_full),
    "| events =", sum(lusc_full$os_status), "\n")

# Verify required columns exist
required_cols <- c("case_id", "os_months", "os_status", "RiskScore")
for (col in required_cols) {
  if (!col %in% colnames(luad_full))
    stop("Column '", col, "' not found in TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv")
  if (!col %in% colnames(lusc_full))
    stop("Column '", col, "' not found in TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv")
}
cat("All required columns present ✓\n")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 2 — Apply 24-month administrative censoring
#
# IMPORTANT: median cutoff is computed on FULL data FIRST,
# then censoring is applied, so the risk group boundary is unaffected
# by the censoring decision.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

apply_censoring <- function(df, censor_time, cohort_label) {

  # Step 1: Median cutoff from full (uncensored) data
  med_cut <- median(df$RiskScore)
  cat(sprintf("\n[%s] Median risk score (full data): %.4f\n",
              cohort_label, med_cut))

  # Step 2: Assign risk group based on full-data median
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      RiskGroup = factor(
        ifelse(RiskScore >= med_cut, "High", "Low"),
        levels = c("Low", "High")
      )
    )

  # Step 3: Apply administrative censoring
  n_censored <- sum(df$os_months > censor_time)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      os_months_c = pmin(os_months, censor_time),
      os_status_c = ifelse(os_months > censor_time, 0, os_status),
      Cohort      = cohort_label
    )

  # Diagnostic summary
  cat(sprintf("[%s] Censored at %d mo: %d patients (events lost: %d)\n",
              cohort_label, censor_time,
              n_censored,
              sum(df$os_status[df$os_months > censor_time])))
  cat(sprintf("[%s] After censoring: n = %d | events = %d\n",
              cohort_label, nrow(df), sum(df$os_status_c)))
  cat(sprintf("[%s] High: n=%d events=%d | Low: n=%d events=%d\n",
              cohort_label,
              sum(df$RiskGroup == "High"),
              sum(df$os_status_c[df$RiskGroup == "High"]),
              sum(df$RiskGroup == "Low"),
              sum(df$os_status_c[df$RiskGroup == "Low"])))

  return(df)
}

luad_c <- apply_censoring(luad_full, CENSOR_TIME, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_c <- apply_censoring(lusc_full, CENSOR_TIME, "TCGA-LUSC")

# Combined cohort — stack both, re-apply median from combined risk scores
combined_raw <- bind_rows(
  luad_full %>% mutate(Cohort = "TCGA-LUAD"),
  lusc_full %>% mutate(Cohort = "TCGA-LUSC")
)
combined_c <- apply_censoring(combined_raw, CENSOR_TIME, "TCGA-LUAD+LUSC (combined)")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 3 — KM + Cox + time-ROC function (24-month censored data)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

MIN_EVENTS <- 5

km_24mo <- function(df, cohort_name,
                    col_hi    = "#B22222",
                    col_lo    = "#1874CD",
                    roc_times = c(12, 24)) {

  # Use censored columns
  n_total  <- nrow(df)
  n_events <- sum(df$os_status_c)

  cat(sprintf("\n══ %s ══\n", cohort_name))
  cat(sprintf("n = %d | events (≤%d mo) = %d (%.1f%%)\n",
              n_total, CENSOR_TIME, n_events,
              100 * n_events / n_total))

  if (n_events < MIN_EVENTS) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠  Skipped: only %d events after %d-mo censoring\n",
                n_events, CENSOR_TIME))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # ── Cox regression (continuous risk score) ─────────────────────────────
  cox_fit <- coxph(Surv(os_months_c, os_status_c) ~ RiskScore,
                   data = df, ties = "efron")
  s      <- summary(cox_fit)
  hr     <- s$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_lo  <- s$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_hi  <- s$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  cox_p  <- s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  cindex <- as.numeric(s$concordance["C"])

  cat(sprintf("Cox  HR = %.3f (%.3f–%.3f)  p = %.4f  C-index = %.3f\n",
              hr, hr_lo, hr_hi, cox_p, cindex))

  # ── Log-rank ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months_c, os_status_c) ~ RiskGroup, data = df)
  lr     <- survdiff(Surv(os_months_c, os_status_c) ~ RiskGroup, data = df)
  lr_p   <- 1 - pchisq(lr$chisq, df = 1)
  cat(sprintf("Log-rank p = %.4f\n", lr_p))

  # ── KM plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  km_subtitle <- sprintf(
    "HR = %.2f (95%% CI: %.2f–%.2f)  |  Cox p = %s  |  Log-rank p = %s  |  C-index = %.3f",
    hr, hr_lo, hr_hi,
    formatC(cox_p, digits = 3, format = "g"),
    formatC(lr_p,  digits = 3, format = "g"),
    cindex
  )

  km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
    km_fit, data = df,
    palette             = c(col_lo, col_hi),
    size                = 0.85,
    pval                = FALSE,
    conf.int            = TRUE,
    conf.int.alpha      = 0.10,
    risk.table          = TRUE,
    risk.table.height   = 0.28,
    risk.table.fontsize = 3,
    risk.table.y.text   = FALSE,
    tables.theme        = theme_cleantable(),
    censor.shape        = "|", censor.size = 3,
    surv.median.line    = "hv",
    legend.labs  = c(paste0("Low risk  (n=", sum(df$RiskGroup == "Low"),  ")"),
                     paste0("High risk (n=", sum(df$RiskGroup == "High"), ")")),
    legend.title = "",
    xlab         = "Time (months)",
    ylab         = "Overall Survival Probability",
    xlim         = c(0, CENSOR_TIME),
    break.time.by = 6,
    ylim         = c(0, 1.02),
    title        = paste0(cohort_name,
                          " — 3-miRNA signature (", CENSOR_TIME, "-month censoring)"),
    ggtheme      = theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey30",
                                          margin = margin(b = 4)),
        legend.position   = c(0.78, 0.84),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill  = "white",
                                          color = "grey80",
                                          linewidth = 0.3)
      )
  )

  km_plot$plot <- km_plot$plot + labs(subtitle = km_subtitle)

  out_km <- paste0("KM_24mo_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", cohort_name), ".png")
  png(out_km, width = 2200, height = 2000, res = 300)
  print(km_plot)
  dev.off()
  cat("KM plot saved →", out_km, "\n")

  # ── Time-dependent ROC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Only include timepoints with ≥ 20 patients still at risk
  valid_times <- roc_times[sapply(roc_times, function(t)
    sum(df$os_months_c >= t) >= 20)]
  cat("ROC timepoints:", paste(valid_times, "mo", collapse = ", "), "\n")

  auc_df <- if (length(valid_times) == 0) {
    cat("  No valid ROC timepoints — skipping.\n")
    data.frame(Cohort = cohort_name, Timepoint = NA_real_,
               AUC = NA_real_, AUC_lower = NA_real_, AUC_upper = NA_real_)
  } else {
    troc <- timeROC(
      T      = df$os_months_c,
      delta  = df$os_status_c,
      marker = df$RiskScore,
      cause  = 1,
      times  = valid_times,
      iid    = TRUE
    )
    auc_vals <- as.numeric(troc$AUC)
    ci_mat   <- confint(troc, level = 0.95)$CI_AUC
    auc_lo   <- as.numeric(ci_mat[, 1])
    auc_hi   <- as.numeric(ci_mat[, 2])

    cat("Time-ROC AUC (95% CI):\n")
    print(data.frame(
      Timepoint = valid_times,
      AUC       = round(auc_vals, 4),
      Lower     = round(auc_lo,   4),
      Upper     = round(auc_hi,   4)
    ))

    n_t      <- length(valid_times)
    roc_cols <- c("#B22222", "#1874CD")[seq_len(n_t)]

    roc_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_t), function(i) {
      data.frame(
        FPR  = troc$FP[, i],
        TPR  = troc$TP[, i],
        Time = sprintf("%d mo  AUC = %.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
                       valid_times[i], auc_vals[i], auc_lo[i], auc_hi[i])
      )
    }))

    p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, color = Time)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                  color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = setNames(roc_cols, unique(roc_df$Time)),
        name   = NULL
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous("1 - Specificity", limits = c(0, 1),
                         expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
      scale_y_continuous("Sensitivity",     limits = c(0, 1),
                         expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0(cohort_name, " — Time-dependent ROC"),
        subtitle = paste0("3-miRNA z-score signature  |  ",
                          CENSOR_TIME, "-month administrative censoring  |  IPCW")
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        legend.position   = c(0.55, 0.12),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 8.5),
        plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        plot.subtitle     = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 8),
        panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio      = 1
      )

    out_roc <- paste0("TimeROC_24mo_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", cohort_name), ".png")
    ggsave(out_roc, p_roc, width = 6.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
    cat("Time-ROC saved →", out_roc, "\n")

    data.frame(
      Cohort    = cohort_name,
      Timepoint = valid_times,
      AUC       = round(auc_vals, 4),
      AUC_lower = round(auc_lo,   4),
      AUC_upper = round(auc_hi,   4)
    )
  }

  # ── Risk score distribution plot ────────────────────────────────────────
  rs_ord <- df %>%
    arrange(RiskScore) %>%
    mutate(idx = row_number())

  p_dist <- ggplot(rs_ord,
                   aes(x = idx, y = RiskScore,
                       color = RiskGroup,
                       shape = factor(os_status_c))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = median(df$RiskScore),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3, alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Low" = col_lo, "High" = col_hi),
                       name = "Risk group") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("0" = 1, "1" = 16),
                       labels = c("Alive / censored", "Dead"),
                       name   = "Status") +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cohort_name, " — Risk score distribution"),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "n=%d | events (≤%d mo)=%d | median cutoff=%.3f",
        nrow(df), CENSOR_TIME, sum(df$os_status_c), median(df$RiskScore)
      ),
      x = "Patients (sorted by risk score)",
      y = "Risk score (z-scored)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  out_dist <- paste0("RiskDist_24mo_",
                     gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", cohort_name), ".png")
  ggsave(out_dist, p_dist, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  cat("Risk dist plot saved →", out_dist, "\n")

  # Return summary stats
  list(
    cohort    = cohort_name,
    n         = n_total,
    events_24 = n_events,
    HR        = hr,  HR_lo = hr_lo,  HR_hi = hr_hi,
    cox_p     = cox_p, lr_p = lr_p, cindex = cindex,
    auc_df    = auc_df
  )
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 4 — Run all three cohorts
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

luad_res  <- km_24mo(luad_c,     "TCGA-LUAD",              roc_times = c(12, 24))
lusc_res  <- km_24mo(lusc_c,     "TCGA-LUSC",              roc_times = c(12, 24))
comb_res  <- km_24mo(combined_c, "TCGA-LUAD+LUSC combined", roc_times = c(12, 24))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 5 — Summary table
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

make_row <- function(res) {
  data.frame(
    Cohort          = res$cohort,
    n               = res$n,
    Events_24mo     = res$events_24,
    HR              = round(res$HR,     3),
    HR_lower95      = round(res$HR_lo,  3),
    HR_upper95      = round(res$HR_hi,  3),
    Cox_p           = formatC(res$cox_p, digits = 3, format = "g"),
    Logrank_p       = formatC(res$lr_p,  digits = 3, format = "g"),
    Cindex          = round(res$cindex, 3)
  )
}

summary_tbl <- bind_rows(
  make_row(luad_res),
  make_row(lusc_res),
  make_row(comb_res)
)

cat("\n══════════ 24-MONTH CENSORED KM SUMMARY ══════════\n")
print(summary_tbl, row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(summary_tbl, "KM_24mo_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# AUC table
auc_tbl <- bind_rows(
  luad_res$auc_df,
  lusc_res$auc_df,
  comb_res$auc_df
)
write.csv(auc_tbl, "KM_24mo_TimeROC_AUC.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n✓ Done. Output files:\n")
cat("  KM plots      : KM_24mo_*.png\n")
cat("  Time-ROC plots: TimeROC_24mo_*.png\n")
cat("  Risk dist     : RiskDist_24mo_*.png\n")
cat("  Summary CSV   : KM_24mo_summary.csv\n")
cat("  AUC CSV       : KM_24mo_TimeROC_AUC.csv\n")
```

#KM ANALYSIS — 24-MONTH CENSORING × STAGE SUBSETS
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# KM ANALYSIS — 24-MONTH CENSORING × STAGE SUBSETS
# Cohorts : TCGA-LUAD  |  TCGA-LUSC
# Subsets :
#   (A) Stage III + IV     (broad group)
#   (B) Stage IIIB + IV    (fine group — advanced)
#   (C) Stage IV only
#
# Inputs  :
#   TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv  — from TCGA_validation_3miRNA_corrected.R
#   TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv
#   TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds          — saved in PART 0 of validation script
#   TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds
#
# Design  :
#   1. Re-attach stage from clinical RDS (same add_stage() logic as before)
#   2. Filter to subset → re-compute median cutoff within subset
#   3. Apply 24-mo administrative censoring
#   4. KM + Cox + time-ROC at 12 & 24 months
#   5. Write one combined summary CSV + AUC CSV
#
# Outputs :
#   KM_{CENSOR_TIME}mo_stage_*.png
#   TimeROC_{CENSOR_TIME}mo_stage_*.png
#   RiskDist_{CENSOR_TIME}mo_stage_*.png
#   KM_{CENSOR_TIME}mo_stage_summary.csv      (file names auto-match CENSOR_TIME)
#   KM_{CENSOR_TIME}mo_stage_AUC.csv
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(timeROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

CENSOR_TIME <- 48    # ← administrative censor point (months)
MIN_N       <- 20    # minimum n per group to run
MIN_EVENTS  <- 5     # minimum events to run

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 1 — Load risk scores + clinical data
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

luad_rs   <- read.csv("TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
lusc_rs   <- read.csv("TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
luad_clin <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds")
lusc_clin <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds")

cat("LUAD risk scores: n =", nrow(luad_rs), "\n")
cat("LUSC risk scores: n =", nrow(lusc_rs), "\n")

# Verify required columns
for (col in c("case_id","os_months","os_status","RiskScore")) {
  if (!col %in% colnames(luad_rs)) stop("Missing '", col, "' in LUAD CSV")
  if (!col %in% colnames(lusc_rs)) stop("Missing '", col, "' in LUSC CSV")
}
cat("Required columns present ✓\n")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 2 — Stage annotation (full add_stage with all fixes from
#          TCGA_validation_3miRNA_corrected.R)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Title-case normaliser for roman numeral stage strings ────────────────
to_title_stage <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return(NA_character_)
    words <- strsplit(tolower(trimws(s)), "\\s+")[[1]]
    words <- sapply(words, function(w) {
      if (w %in% c("i","ia","ib","ii","iia","iib",
                   "iii","iiia","iiib","iv","iva","ivb")) {
        toupper(w)
      } else {
        paste0(toupper(substr(w,1,1)), substr(w,2,nchar(w)))
      }
    })
    paste(words, collapse = " ")
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

add_stage <- function(risk_df, clin_df, cohort_name) {

  colnames(clin_df) <- tolower(colnames(clin_df))

  cat("\n[STAGE]", cohort_name, "— attaching stage annotation\n")

  barcode_col <- intersect(
    c("bcr_patient_barcode", "submitter_id", "case_id"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]

  stage_col <- intersect(
    c("ajcc_pathologic_stage",
      "ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage",
      "tumor_stage",
      "clinical_stage",
      "pathologic_stage",
      "stage_event.pathologic_stage"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]

  # Emergency: search for any column containing "stage"
  if (is.na(stage_col)) {
    candidates <- grep("stage", colnames(clin_df), value = TRUE)
    cat("[STAGE] ⚠ No known stage column. Candidates:", paste(candidates, collapse=", "), "\n")
    warning(cohort_name, ": stage column not found")
    return(risk_df %>%
             mutate(stage_group = NA_character_, stage_fine = NA_character_))
  }

  cat("[STAGE] Column used:", stage_col, "\n")

  # Show raw values for debugging
  raw_vals <- sort(unique(clin_df[[stage_col]]))
  cat("[STAGE] Unique raw values:", paste(raw_vals, collapse=" | "), "\n")

  stage_df <- clin_df %>%
    mutate(
      case_id   = toupper(substr(.data[[barcode_col]], 1, 12)),
      stage_raw = to_title_stage(.data[[stage_col]])
    ) %>%
    select(case_id, stage_raw) %>%
    distinct(case_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      # ── Broad group: I / II / III / IV ──────────────────────────────
      stage_group = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I",   "Stage IA",  "Stage IB")   ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II",  "Stage IIA", "Stage IIB")  ~ "II",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage III", "Stage IIIA","Stage IIIB") ~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV",  "Stage IVA", "Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE                                                       ~ NA_character_
      ),
      # ── Fine group: IIIA / IIIB / undifferentiated III kept separate ─
      stage_fine = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I",   "Stage IA",  "Stage IB")   ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II",  "Stage IIA", "Stage IIB")  ~ "II",
        stage_raw == "Stage IIIA"                                  ~ "IIIA",
        stage_raw == "Stage IIIB"                                  ~ "IIIB",
        stage_raw == "Stage III"                                   ~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV",  "Stage IVA", "Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE                                                       ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  merged <- risk_df %>%
    left_join(stage_df %>% select(case_id, stage_group, stage_fine),
              by = "case_id")

  n_staged <- sum(!is.na(merged$stage_group))
  cat(sprintf("[STAGE] %d / %d samples annotated with stage\n",
              n_staged, nrow(merged)))

  if (n_staged == 0) {
    cat("[STAGE] ⚠ Zero samples staged — check case_id format:\n")
    cat("  risk_df:  ", paste(head(risk_df$case_id, 3), collapse=", "), "\n")
    cat("  clinical: ", paste(head(stage_df$case_id, 3), collapse=", "), "\n")
  }

  cat("[STAGE] Distribution (fine):\n")
  print(table(merged$stage_fine, useNA = "ifany"))

  return(merged)
}

luad_staged <- add_stage(luad_rs, luad_clin, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_staged <- add_stage(lusc_rs, lusc_clin, "TCGA-LUSC")

# Hard stop if staging failed entirely
if (all(is.na(luad_staged$stage_group)))
  stop("LUAD staging failed — check [STAGE] output above.")
if (all(is.na(lusc_staged$stage_group)))
  stop("LUSC staging failed — check [STAGE] output above.")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 3 — 24-month censoring function
# Median cutoff is fixed on the SUBSET (before censoring)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

apply_censor <- function(df, label) {

  n_over  <- sum(df$os_months > CENSOR_TIME)
  ev_lost <- sum(df$os_status[df$os_months > CENSOR_TIME])

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      # Median cutoff computed on subset BEFORE censoring
      RiskGroup   = factor(
        ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore), "High", "Low"),
        levels = c("Low", "High")
      ),
      os_months_c = pmin(os_months, CENSOR_TIME),
      os_status_c = ifelse(os_months > CENSOR_TIME, 0L, as.integer(os_status))
    )

  cat(sprintf("\n[CENSOR] %s | n=%d | censored at %d mo: %d pts | events lost: %d | remaining events: %d\n",
              label, nrow(df), CENSOR_TIME, n_over, ev_lost,
              sum(df$os_status_c)))
  cat(sprintf("  High: n=%d events=%d | Low: n=%d events=%d\n",
              sum(df$RiskGroup=="High"), sum(df$os_status_c[df$RiskGroup=="High"]),
              sum(df$RiskGroup=="Low"),  sum(df$os_status_c[df$RiskGroup=="Low"])))

  df
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 4 — KM + Cox + time-ROC function
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

km_stage_24mo <- function(df, label,
                           col_hi    = "#B22222",
                           col_lo    = "#1874CD",
                           roc_times = seq(12, CENSOR_TIME, by = 12)) {

  n_total  <- nrow(df)
  n_events <- sum(df$os_status_c)

  cat(sprintf("\n══ %s ══  n=%d | events=%d\n", label, n_total, n_events))

  # ── Guard ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (n_total < MIN_N || n_events < MIN_EVENTS) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠  Skipped (n=%d < %d  OR  events=%d < %d)\n",
                n_total, MIN_N, n_events, MIN_EVENTS))
    return(list(
      label = label, n = n_total, events = n_events,
      HR = NA, HR_lo = NA, HR_hi = NA,
      cox_p = NA, lr_p = NA, cindex = NA,
      auc_df = data.frame(Label=label, Timepoint=NA_real_,
                          AUC=NA_real_, AUC_lower=NA_real_,
                          AUC_upper=NA_real_),
      skipped = TRUE
    ))
  }

  # ── Cox (continuous) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cox_fit <- coxph(Surv(os_months_c, os_status_c) ~ RiskScore,
                   data = df, ties = "efron")
  s      <- summary(cox_fit)
  hr     <- s$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_lo  <- s$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_hi  <- s$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  cox_p  <- s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  cindex <- as.numeric(s$concordance["C"])

  cat(sprintf("Cox HR=%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)  p=%.4f  C-index=%.3f\n",
              hr, hr_lo, hr_hi, cox_p, cindex))

  # ── Log-rank ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months_c, os_status_c) ~ RiskGroup, data = df)
  lr     <- survdiff(Surv(os_months_c, os_status_c) ~ RiskGroup, data = df)
  lr_p   <- 1 - pchisq(lr$chisq, df = 1)
  cat(sprintf("Log-rank p=%.4f\n", lr_p))

  # ── KM plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  subtitle_str <- sprintf(
    "HR=%.2f (95%% CI: %.2f–%.2f)  |  Cox p=%s  |  Log-rank p=%s  |  C-index=%.3f",
    hr, hr_lo, hr_hi,
    formatC(cox_p, digits=3, format="g"),
    formatC(lr_p,  digits=3, format="g"),
    cindex
  )

  km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
    km_fit, data = df,
    palette             = c(col_lo, col_hi),
    size                = 0.85,
    pval                = FALSE,
    conf.int            = TRUE,
    conf.int.alpha      = 0.10,
    risk.table          = TRUE,
    risk.table.height   = 0.28,
    risk.table.fontsize = 3,
    risk.table.y.text   = FALSE,
    tables.theme        = theme_cleantable(),
    censor.shape        = "|", censor.size = 3,
    surv.median.line    = "hv",
    legend.labs  = c(
      paste0("Low risk  (n=", sum(df$RiskGroup=="Low"),  ")"),
      paste0("High risk (n=", sum(df$RiskGroup=="High"), ")")
    ),
    legend.title  = "",
    xlab          = "Time (months)",
    ylab          = "Overall Survival Probability",
    xlim          = c(0, CENSOR_TIME),
    break.time.by = 6,
    ylim          = c(0, 1.02),
    title         = paste0(label, "  [", CENSOR_TIME, "-mo censoring]"),
    ggtheme       = theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey30",
                                          margin = margin(b = 4)),
        legend.position   = c(0.78, 0.84),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill  = "white",
                                          color = "grey80",
                                          linewidth = 0.3)
      )
  )
  km_plot$plot <- km_plot$plot + labs(subtitle = subtitle_str)

  slug    <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", label)
  out_km  <- paste0("KM_", CENSOR_TIME, "mo_stage_", slug, ".png")
  png(out_km, width = 2200, height = 2000, res = 300)
  print(km_plot)
  dev.off()
  cat("KM saved →", out_km, "\n")

  # ── Time-dependent ROC ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  valid_times <- roc_times[sapply(roc_times, function(t)
    sum(df$os_months_c >= t) >= 20)]
  cat("ROC timepoints:", paste(valid_times, "mo", collapse=", "), "\n")

  auc_df <- if (length(valid_times) == 0) {
    cat("  ⚠ No valid ROC timepoints.\n")
    data.frame(Label=label, Timepoint=NA_real_,
               AUC=NA_real_, AUC_lower=NA_real_, AUC_upper=NA_real_)
  } else {
    troc     <- timeROC(T=df$os_months_c, delta=df$os_status_c,
                        marker=df$RiskScore, cause=1,
                        times=valid_times, iid=TRUE)
    auc_vals <- as.numeric(troc$AUC)

    # Safe CI extraction: pad with NA if confint() returns fewer rows
    ci_raw <- tryCatch(
      confint(troc, level=0.95)$CI_AUC,
      error = function(e) {
        cat("  \u26a0 confint() failed:", conditionMessage(e), "— CIs set to NA\n")
        matrix(NA_real_, nrow=length(valid_times), ncol=2)
      }
    )
    n_ci <- nrow(ci_raw)
    n_tp <- length(valid_times)
    if (n_ci < n_tp) {
      cat(sprintf("  \u26a0 CI matrix has %d rows but %d timepoints — padding with NA\n",
                  n_ci, n_tp))
      ci_raw <- rbind(ci_raw, matrix(NA_real_, nrow=n_tp - n_ci, ncol=2))
    }
    auc_lo <- as.numeric(ci_raw[,1])
    auc_hi <- as.numeric(ci_raw[,2])

    cat("Time-ROC AUC (95% CI):\n")
    print(data.frame(Timepoint=valid_times,
                     AUC=round(auc_vals,4),
                     Lower=round(auc_lo,4),
                     Upper=round(auc_hi,4)))

    n_t      <- length(valid_times)
    roc_cols <- c("#B22222","#1874CD")[seq_len(n_t)]

    roc_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_t), function(i) {
      data.frame(
        FPR  = troc$FP[,i], TPR = troc$TP[,i],
        Time = sprintf("%d mo  AUC=%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
                       valid_times[i], auc_vals[i], auc_lo[i], auc_hi[i])
      )
    }))

    p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x=FPR, y=TPR, color=Time)) +
      geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed",
                  color="grey60", linewidth=0.5) +
      geom_line(linewidth=0.9) +
      scale_color_manual(values=setNames(roc_cols, unique(roc_df$Time)),
                         name=NULL) +
      scale_x_continuous("1 - Specificity", limits=c(0,1), expand=c(0.01,0)) +
      scale_y_continuous("Sensitivity",     limits=c(0,1), expand=c(0.01,0)) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0(label, " — Time-ROC"),
        subtitle = paste0("3-miRNA z-score  |  ",
                          CENSOR_TIME, "-mo censoring  |  IPCW  |  95% CI in legend")
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size=10) +
      theme(
        legend.position   = c(0.52, 0.12),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="grey80"),
        legend.text       = element_text(size=8),
        plot.title        = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
        plot.subtitle     = element_text(color="grey40", size=8),
        panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio      = 1
      )

    out_roc <- paste0("TimeROC_", CENSOR_TIME, "mo_stage_", slug, ".png")
    ggsave(out_roc, p_roc, width=6.5, height=6.5, dpi=300)
    cat("Time-ROC saved →", out_roc, "\n")

    data.frame(Label=label, Timepoint=valid_times,
               AUC=round(auc_vals,4),
               AUC_lower=round(auc_lo,4),
               AUC_upper=round(auc_hi,4))
  }

  # ── Risk distribution ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  rs_ord <- df %>% arrange(RiskScore) %>% mutate(idx=row_number())

  p_dist <- ggplot(rs_ord,
                   aes(x=idx, y=RiskScore,
                       color=RiskGroup, shape=factor(os_status_c))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=median(df$RiskScore),
               linetype="dashed", color="grey40", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_point(size=1.3, alpha=0.75) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("Low"=col_lo,"High"=col_hi), name="Risk") +
    scale_shape_manual(values=c("0"=1,"1"=16),
                       labels=c("Alive/censored","Dead"), name="Status") +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(label, " — Risk score distribution"),
      subtitle = sprintf("n=%d | events(≤%d mo)=%d | median cut=%.3f",
                         nrow(df), CENSOR_TIME,
                         sum(df$os_status_c), median(df$RiskScore)),
      x="Patients (sorted by risk score)", y="Risk score (z-scored)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size=10) +
    theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=11),
          plot.subtitle=element_text(color="grey40",size=9),
          panel.grid.minor=element_blank())

  out_dist <- paste0("RiskDist_", CENSOR_TIME, "mo_stage_", slug, ".png")
  ggsave(out_dist, p_dist, width=8, height=4, dpi=300)
  cat("Risk dist saved →", out_dist, "\n")

  list(label=label, n=n_total, events=n_events,
       HR=hr, HR_lo=hr_lo, HR_hi=hr_hi,
       cox_p=cox_p, lr_p=lr_p, cindex=cindex,
       auc_df=auc_df, skipped=FALSE)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 5 — Build and censor all subsets, then run
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Helper: filter → censor → run in one call
run_stage_subset <- function(staged_df, stage_values, stage_col_name,
                              cohort_label, subset_label,
                              roc_times = seq(12, CENSOR_TIME, by=12)) {

  sub <- staged_df %>%
    filter(.data[[stage_col_name]] %in% stage_values)

  full_label <- paste0(cohort_label, " (", subset_label, ")")

  if (nrow(sub) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("\n[SKIP] %s — 0 rows after stage filter (values: %s)\n",
                full_label, paste(stage_values, collapse="+")))
    return(list(label=full_label, n=0, events=0,
                HR=NA, HR_lo=NA, HR_hi=NA,
                cox_p=NA, lr_p=NA, cindex=NA,
                auc_df=data.frame(Label=full_label, Timepoint=NA_real_,
                                  AUC=NA_real_, AUC_lower=NA_real_,
                                  AUC_upper=NA_real_),
                skipped=TRUE))
  }

  sub_c <- apply_censor(sub, full_label)
  km_stage_24mo(sub_c, full_label, roc_times = roc_times)
}

# ── (A) Stage III + IV  (broad) ───────────────────────────────────────────
luad_III_IV   <- run_stage_subset(luad_staged, c("III","IV"), "stage_group",
                                   "TCGA-LUAD", "Stage III+IV",
                                   roc_times = seq(12, CENSOR_TIME, by=12))
lusc_III_IV   <- run_stage_subset(lusc_staged, c("III","IV"), "stage_group",

# ── (B) Stage IIIB + IV  (fine) ───────────────────────────────────────────

lusc_IIIb_IV  <- run_stage_subset(lusc_staged, c("IIIB","IV"), "stage_fine",

# ── (C) Stage IV only ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
luad_IV       <- run_stage_subset(luad_staged, "IV", "stage_group",
                                   "TCGA-LUAD", "Stage IV only",

lusc_IV       <- run_stage_subset(lusc_staged, "IV", "stage_group",
                                   "TCGA-LUSC", "Stage IV only",
                                   roc_times = seq(12, CENSOR_TIME, by=12))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 6 — Combined summary tables
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

make_row <- function(res) {
  if (isTRUE(res$skipped)) {
    return(data.frame(
      Label         = res$label,
      n             = res$n,
      Events_censored   = res$events,
      HR            = NA_real_, HR_lower95 = NA_real_, HR_upper95 = NA_real_,
      Cox_p         = NA_character_,
      Logrank_p     = NA_character_,
      Cindex        = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  data.frame(
    Label         = res$label,
    n             = res$n,
    Events_censored   = res$events,
    HR            = round(res$HR,     3),
    HR_lower95    = round(res$HR_lo,  3),
    HR_upper95    = round(res$HR_hi,  3),
    Cox_p         = formatC(res$cox_p, digits=3, format="g"),
    Logrank_p     = formatC(res$lr_p,  digits=3, format="g"),
    Cindex        = round(res$cindex, 3)
  )
}

summary_tbl <- bind_rows(
  make_row(luad_III_IV),
  make_row(lusc_III_IV),
  make_row(luad_IIIb_IV),
  make_row(lusc_IIIb_IV),
  make_row(luad_IV),
  make_row(lusc_IV)
)

cat("\n══════════ 24-MO CENSORED — STAGE SUBSET SUMMARY ══════════\n")

write.csv(summary_tbl, paste0("KM_", CENSOR_TIME, "mo_stage_summary.csv"), row.names=FALSE)

  luad_IV$auc_df,      lusc_IV$auc_df

cat("  Time-ROC      : TimeROC_", CENSOR_TIME, "mo_stage_*.png   (6 files)\n", sep="")
```
