#TNM
```{r}
#install.packages('dunn.test')
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RISK SCORE vs TNM STAGE COMPARISON
# Cohorts : TCGA-LUAD  |  TCGA-LUSC  |  Pooled
# Comparisons :
#   (1) Overall AJCC stage  (I / II / III / IV)
#   (2) T stage             (T1 / T2 / T3 / T4)
#   (3) N stage             (N0 / N1 / N2 / N3)
#   (4) M stage             (M0 / M1)
#
# Inputs  :
#   TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv
#   TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv
#   TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds
#   TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds
#
# Tests   :
#   ≥ 3 groups → Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn pairwise (Holm correction)
#   2 groups   → Wilcoxon rank-sum
#
# Outputs :
#   Stage_RiskScore_*.png   (one file per stage type × cohort set)
#   RiskScore_vs_Stage_summary.csv
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)       # stat_compare_means, geom_bracket
library(dunn.test)    # Dunn post-hoc
library(tidyr)

OUT_DIR <- "Output_StageComparison"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 1 — Load data
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

luad_rs   <- read.csv("TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
lusc_rs   <- read.csv("TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
luad_clin <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds")
lusc_clin <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds")

cat("LUAD n =", nrow(luad_rs), "| LUSC n =", nrow(lusc_rs), "\n")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 2 — Stage annotation (AJCC overall + T / N / M)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Roman-numeral-aware title casing ─────────────────────────────────────
to_title_stage <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return(NA_character_)
    words <- strsplit(tolower(trimws(s)), "\\s+")[[1]]
    words <- sapply(words, function(w) {
      if (w %in% c("i","ia","ib","ii","iia","iib",
                   "iii","iiia","iiib","iv","iva","ivb")) toupper(w)
      else paste0(toupper(substr(w,1,1)), substr(w,2,nchar(w)))
    })
    paste(words, collapse = " ")
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# ── Collapse T/N/M to coarse categories ──────────────────────────────────
coarsen_T <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    grepl("^T1", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "T1",
    grepl("^T2", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "T2",
    grepl("^T3", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "T3",
    grepl("^T4", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "T4",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

coarsen_N <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    grepl("^N0", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "N0",
    grepl("^N1", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "N1",
    grepl("^N2", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "N2",
    grepl("^N3", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "N3",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

coarsen_M <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    grepl("^M0", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "M0",
    grepl("^M1", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "M1",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# ── Main annotation function ──────────────────────────────────────────────
attach_tnm <- function(risk_df, clin_df, cohort_name) {

  colnames(clin_df) <- tolower(colnames(clin_df))
  cat("\n[TNM]", cohort_name, "\n")

  # Barcode column
  barcode_col <- intersect(
    c("bcr_patient_barcode", "submitter_id", "case_id"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]

  # Overall stage column
  stage_col <- intersect(
    c("ajcc_pathologic_stage",
      "ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage",
      "tumor_stage", "clinical_stage", "pathologic_stage"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]

  # T / N / M columns — current GDC names first, legacy names as fallback
  t_col <- intersect(
    c("ajcc_pathologic_t", "pathologic_t", "tumor_T",
      "stage_event.tnm_categories.pathologic_categories.pathologic_t"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]
  n_col <- intersect(
    c("ajcc_pathologic_n", "pathologic_n", "tumor_N",
      "stage_event.tnm_categories.pathologic_categories.pathologic_n"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]
  m_col <- intersect(
    c("ajcc_pathologic_m", "pathologic_m", "tumor_M",
      "stage_event.tnm_categories.pathologic_categories.pathologic_m"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]

  cat("  Columns → stage:", stage_col,
      "| T:", t_col, "| N:", n_col, "| M:", m_col, "\n")

  # Diagnostic: raw T/N/M values (helps debug if coarsening misses anything)
  if (!is.na(t_col)) cat("  Raw T values:", paste(sort(unique(clin_df[[t_col]])), collapse=", "), "\n")
  if (!is.na(n_col)) cat("  Raw N values:", paste(sort(unique(clin_df[[n_col]])), collapse=", "), "\n")
  if (!is.na(m_col)) cat("  Raw M values:", paste(sort(unique(clin_df[[m_col]])), collapse=", "), "\n")

  # Build annotation table
  ann <- clin_df %>%
    mutate(
      case_id   = toupper(substr(.data[[barcode_col]], 1, 12)),
      stage_raw = if (!is.na(stage_col)) to_title_stage(.data[[stage_col]]) else NA_character_,
      t_raw     = if (!is.na(t_col)) toupper(trimws(.data[[t_col]])) else NA_character_,
      n_raw     = if (!is.na(n_col)) toupper(trimws(.data[[n_col]])) else NA_character_,
      m_raw     = if (!is.na(m_col)) toupper(trimws(.data[[m_col]])) else NA_character_
    ) %>%
    select(case_id, stage_raw, t_raw, n_raw, m_raw) %>%
    distinct(case_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      # Overall AJCC stage — broad (I/II/III/IV)
      stage_group = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I",   "Stage IA",  "Stage IB")   ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II",  "Stage IIA", "Stage IIB")  ~ "II",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage III", "Stage IIIA","Stage IIIB") ~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV",  "Stage IVA", "Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE                                                       ~ NA_character_
      ),
      # Coarsened T / N / M
      T_stage = coarsen_T(t_raw),
      N_stage = coarsen_N(n_raw),
      M_stage = coarsen_M(m_raw)
    )

  merged <- risk_df %>%
    left_join(ann %>% select(case_id, stage_group, T_stage, N_stage, M_stage),
              by = "case_id")

  cat("  stage_group distribution:\n")
  print(table(merged$stage_group, useNA = "ifany"))
  cat("  T_stage distribution:\n")
  print(table(merged$T_stage, useNA = "ifany"))
  cat("  N_stage distribution:\n")
  print(table(merged$N_stage, useNA = "ifany"))
  cat("  M_stage distribution:\n")
  print(table(merged$M_stage, useNA = "ifany"))

  merged
}

luad_ann <- attach_tnm(luad_rs, luad_clin, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_ann <- attach_tnm(lusc_rs, lusc_clin, "TCGA-LUSC")

# ── Pooled cohort ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pooled_ann <- bind_rows(
  luad_ann %>% mutate(Cohort = "TCGA-LUAD"),
  lusc_ann %>% mutate(Cohort = "TCGA-LUSC")
)

cat("\nPooled: n =", nrow(pooled_ann), "\n")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 3 — Plotting & statistical test functions
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Colour palettes
STAGE_COLS <- c(
  "I"   = "#2ECC71",
  "II"  = "#F1C40F",
  "III" = "#E67E22",
  "IV"  = "#E74C3C"
)

T_COLS <- c(
  "T1" = "#3498DB",
  "T2" = "#27AE60",
  "T3" = "#E67E22",
  "T4" = "#C0392B"
)

N_COLS <- c(
  "N0" = "#1ABC9C",
  "N1" = "#F39C12",
  "N2" = "#E74C3C",
  "N3" = "#8E44AD"
)

M_COLS <- c(
  "M0" = "#2980B9",
  "M1" = "#E74C3C"
)

# ── Dunn test helper — returns a tidy data frame of significant pairs ─────
run_dunn <- function(df, group_col) {
  grps  <- df[[group_col]]
  score <- df$RiskScore
  keep  <- !is.na(grps) & !is.na(score)
  grps  <- grps[keep]; score <- score[keep]

  if (length(unique(grps)) < 2) return(NULL)
  if (length(unique(grps)) == 2) {
    p <- wilcox.test(score ~ grps)$p.value
    lvls <- sort(unique(grps))
    return(data.frame(
      group1 = lvls[1], group2 = lvls[2],
      p.adj  = p,
      label  = ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
               ifelse(p < 0.01,  "**",
               ifelse(p < 0.05,  "*", "ns")))
    ))
  }
  dt <- dunn.test(score, grps, method = "holm", kw = TRUE,
                   label = FALSE, table = FALSE)
  data.frame(
    group1 = sub(" - .*",    "", dt$comparisons),
    group2 = sub(".* - ",    "", dt$comparisons),
    p.adj  = dt$P.adjusted,
    label  = ifelse(dt$P.adjusted < 0.001, "***",
             ifelse(dt$P.adjusted < 0.01,  "**",
             ifelse(dt$P.adjusted < 0.05,  "*", "ns")))
  ) %>% filter(label != "ns")   # only show significant pairs on plot
}

# ── Boxplot with KW global p + significant pairwise brackets ─────────────
plot_stage_box <- function(df, group_col, stage_levels,
                            col_vec, cohort_label,
                            x_label, y_label = "3-miRNA Risk Score") {

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]]),
           .data[[group_col]] %in% stage_levels) %>%
    mutate(StageVar = factor(.data[[group_col]], levels = stage_levels))

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0 || length(unique(plot_df$StageVar)) < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", cohort_label, group_col, "— insufficient groups\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Global Kruskal-Wallis (or Wilcoxon for 2 groups)
  n_groups <- length(unique(plot_df$StageVar))
  if (n_groups > 2) {
    kw_p <- kruskal.test(RiskScore ~ StageVar, data = plot_df)$p.value
    test_label <- paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ",
                          formatC(kw_p, digits = 3, format = "g"))
  } else {
    kw_p <- wilcox.test(RiskScore ~ StageVar, data = plot_df)$p.value
    test_label <- paste0("Wilcoxon p = ",
                          formatC(kw_p, digits = 3, format = "g"))
  }

  # Per-group sample sizes for x-axis labels
  ns <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(StageVar) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  x_labs <- setNames(
    paste0(ns$StageVar, "\n(n=", ns$n, ")"),
    as.character(ns$StageVar)
  )

  # Pairwise significant brackets
  sig_pairs <- run_dunn(plot_df, "StageVar")

  # Base plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = StageVar, y = RiskScore, fill = StageVar)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.45, color = "grey30") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = col_vec, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labs) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cohort_label, "  —  Risk Score by ", x_label),
      subtitle = test_label,
      x        = x_label,
      y        = y_label
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 10,
                                       face = "italic"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  # Add significant pairwise brackets if any
  if (!is.null(sig_pairs) && nrow(sig_pairs) > 0) {
    # Compute step heights for brackets (stacked)
    y_max <- max(plot_df$RiskScore, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_rng <- diff(range(plot_df$RiskScore, na.rm = TRUE))
    step  <- y_rng * 0.10

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(sig_pairs))) {
      g1  <- as.character(sig_pairs$group1[i])
      g2  <- as.character(sig_pairs$group2[i])
      # Only add if both levels exist in factor
      if (g1 %in% levels(plot_df$StageVar) &&
          g2 %in% levels(plot_df$StageVar)) {
        y_pos <- y_max + i * step
        p <- p +
          geom_bracket(
            xmin  = g1, xmax = g2,
            y.position = y_pos,
            label = sig_pairs$label[i],
            tip.length = 0.01,
            label.size = 3.5,
            inherit.aes = FALSE
          )
      }
    }
  }

  p
}

save_png <- function(p, filename, w = 2000, h = 1800) {
  path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, filename)
  png(path, width = w, height = h, res = 300)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  cat("Saved:", path, "\n")
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 4 — Generate all plots
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

datasets <- list(
  "TCGA-LUAD"   = luad_ann %>% mutate(Cohort = "TCGA-LUAD"),
  "TCGA-LUSC"   = lusc_ann %>% mutate(Cohort = "TCGA-LUSC"),
  "LUAD+LUSC"   = pooled_ann
)

comparisons <- list(
  list(col = "stage_group",
       levels = c("I","II","III","IV"),
       colors = STAGE_COLS,
       xlabel = "AJCC Overall Stage",
       slug   = "AJCC_Stage"),
  list(col = "T_stage",
       levels = c("T1","T2","T3","T4"),
       colors = T_COLS,
       xlabel = "T Stage",
       slug   = "T_Stage"),
  list(col = "N_stage",
       levels = c("N0","N1","N2","N3"),
       colors = N_COLS,
       xlabel = "N Stage",
       slug   = "N_Stage"),
  list(col = "M_stage",
       levels = c("M0","M1"),
       colors = M_COLS,
       xlabel = "M Stage",
       slug   = "M_Stage")
)

all_summary <- list()

for (dname in names(datasets)) {
  df <- datasets[[dname]]
  slug_cohort <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", dname)

  for (comp in comparisons) {
    p <- plot_stage_box(
      df,
      group_col     = comp$col,
      stage_levels  = comp$levels,
      col_vec       = comp$colors,
      cohort_label  = dname,
      x_label       = comp$xlabel
    )

    if (!is.null(p)) {
      filename <- paste0("Stage_RiskScore_", comp$slug, "_", slug_cohort, ".png")
      save_png(p, filename)

      # Collect summary stats
      sub_df <- df %>%
        filter(!is.na(.data[[comp$col]]),
               .data[[comp$col]] %in% comp$levels)
      grp_stats <- sub_df %>%
        group_by(Stage = .data[[comp$col]]) %>%
        summarise(
          n      = n(),
          Median = round(median(RiskScore, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          Mean   = round(mean(RiskScore,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          SD     = round(sd(RiskScore,     na.rm = TRUE), 4),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        mutate(Cohort = dname, Stage_Type = comp$slug)

      all_summary[[length(all_summary) + 1]] <- grp_stats
    }
  }
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 5 — Combined summary CSV
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

summary_df <- bind_rows(all_summary) %>%
  select(Cohort, Stage_Type, Stage, n, Median, Mean, SD)

print(summary_df, n = Inf)

write.csv(summary_df,
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "RiskScore_vs_Stage_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n✓ All done. Outputs in:", OUT_DIR, "\n")
cat("  Plots  : Stage_RiskScore_<StageType>_<Cohort>.png  (", 
    length(comparisons) * length(datasets), " files)\n")
cat("  Summary: RiskScore_vs_Stage_summary.csv\n")
```

# risk score and treatement response
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RISK SCORE vs PRIMARY THERAPY OUTCOME — TCGA-LUAD & TCGA-LUSC
#
# Key fix: response data lives in clinical SUPPLEMENT (BCR XML),
#          specifically clinical.info = "follow_up" →
#          column: primary_therapy_outcome_success
#          NOT in the flat GDCquery_clinic() table.
#
# Inputs  :
#   TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv   (from TCGA validation script)
#   TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv
#   (Clinical supplement downloaded fresh below)
#
# Outputs :
#   Output_TxResponse/ folder
#     RiskScore_PrimaryResponse_4level_*.png
#     RiskScore_PrimaryResponse_Binary_*.png
#     ResponseBar_byRiskGroup_*.png
#     KM_RiskGroup_x_Response_*.png
#     RiskScore_vs_PrimaryResponse_summary.csv
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(scales)

OUT_DIR <- "Output_TxResponse"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_png <- function(p, filename, w = 2200, h = 2000) {
  path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, filename)
  png(path, width = w, height = h, res = 300)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  cat("Saved:", path, "\n")
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 0 — Control flags
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

RUN_DOWNLOAD_LUAD <- FALSE   # ← TRUE only on first run
RUN_DOWNLOAD_LUSC <- FALSE   # ← TRUE only on first run


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 1 — Download & parse clinical supplement (follow_up + drug)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

get_followup_drug <- function(project, run_download, rds_prefix) {

  fu_rds   <- paste0(rds_prefix, "_followup.rds")
  drug_rds <- paste0(rds_prefix, "_drug.rds")

  if (!run_download && file.exists(fu_rds) && file.exists(drug_rds)) {
    cat(project, "— Loading supplement from RDS...\n")
    fu   <- readRDS(fu_rds)
    drug <- readRDS(drug_rds)
    return(list(followup = fu, drug = drug))
  }

  cat("\n── Downloading Clinical Supplement for", project, "──\n")

  q <- GDCquery(
    project       = project,
    data.category = "Clinical",
    data.type     = "Clinical Supplement",
    data.format   = "BCR XML"
  )
  GDCdownload(q, method = "api")

  fu <- tryCatch(
    GDCprepare_clinic(q, clinical.info = "follow_up"),
    error = function(e) { cat("  ⚠ follow_up failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL }
  )
  drug <- tryCatch(
    GDCprepare_clinic(q, clinical.info = "drug"),
    error = function(e) { cat("  ⚠ drug failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"); NULL }
  )

  if (!is.null(fu))   saveRDS(fu,   fu_rds)
  if (!is.null(drug)) saveRDS(drug, drug_rds)

  cat("  Saved:", fu_rds, "&", drug_rds, "\n")
  list(followup = fu, drug = drug)
}

luad_supp <- get_followup_drug("TCGA-LUAD", RUN_DOWNLOAD_LUAD, "TCGA_LUAD")
lusc_supp <- get_followup_drug("TCGA-LUSC", RUN_DOWNLOAD_LUSC, "TCGA_LUSC")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 2 — Diagnostic: inspect follow_up and drug columns
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

inspect_supplement <- function(supp, cohort) {
  cat("\n════════════════════════════════════\n")
  cat("[DIAG]", cohort, "\n")
  cat("════════════════════════════════════\n")

  fu <- supp$followup
  if (!is.null(fu)) {
    colnames(fu) <- tolower(colnames(fu))
    cat("follow_up: nrow=", nrow(fu), "ncol=", ncol(fu), "\n")

    # Show response-related columns
    resp_cols <- grep("response|outcome|therapy|treat|measure|recist",
                      colnames(fu), value=TRUE, ignore.case=TRUE)
    cat("  Response-related columns:", paste(resp_cols, collapse=", "), "\n")
    for (col in resp_cols) {
      cat(sprintf("  %s:\n", col))
      print(table(fu[[col]], useNA="ifany"))
    }
  }

  drug <- supp$drug
  if (!is.null(drug)) {
    colnames(drug) <- tolower(colnames(drug))
    cat("\ndrug: nrow=", nrow(drug), "ncol=", ncol(drug), "\n")

    tx_cols <- grep("therapy_type|drug_name|pharmaceutical|measure|response",
                    colnames(drug), value=TRUE, ignore.case=TRUE)
    cat("  Treatment-related columns:", paste(tx_cols, collapse=", "), "\n")
    for (col in tx_cols) {
      vals <- table(drug[[col]], useNA="ifany")
      if (length(vals) <= 30) {
        cat(sprintf("  %s:\n", col)); print(vals)
      } else {
        cat(sprintf("  %s: %d unique values\n", col, length(vals)))
      }
    }
  }
}

inspect_supplement(luad_supp, "TCGA-LUAD")
inspect_supplement(lusc_supp, "TCGA-LUSC")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 3 — Build per-patient response table from follow_up
#          primary_therapy_outcome_success is the key column
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

build_response_table <- function(supp, cohort) {

  fu <- supp$followup
  if (is.null(fu)) {
    cat("⚠", cohort, "— no follow_up data\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  colnames(fu) <- tolower(colnames(fu))

  # Barcode column
  bc_col <- intersect(
    c("bcr_patient_barcode", "submitter_id", "case_id"),
    colnames(fu))[1]

  # Response column — your script confirmed this name
  resp_col <- intersect(
    c("primary_therapy_outcome_success",
      "measure_of_response",
      "treatment_best_response",
      "therapy_outcome_first_course"),
    colnames(fu))[1]

  cat("\n[BUILD]", cohort,
      "| barcode:", bc_col, "| response:", resp_col, "\n")

  if (is.na(resp_col)) {
    cat("  ⚠ No response column found. Available:\n")
    cat(paste(colnames(fu), collapse=", "), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Harmonise TCGA response strings → standard RECIST labels
  fu_clean <- fu %>%
    mutate(
      case_id      = toupper(substr(.data[[bc_col]], 1, 12)),
      response_raw = as.character(.data[[resp_col]]),
      response_recist = case_when(
        grepl("complete remission|complete response|^CR$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)          ~ "CR",
        grepl("partial remission|partial response|^PR$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)           ~ "PR",
        grepl("stable|no change|^SD$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)           ~ "SD",
        grepl("progress|^PD$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)           ~ "PD",
        grepl("^NA$|not evaluated|unknown|indeterminate",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)           ~ NA_character_,
        TRUE                                            ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_recist)) %>%
    # One row per patient: keep best response (CR > PR > SD > PD)
    mutate(resp_rank = match(response_recist, c("CR","PR","SD","PD"))) %>%
    group_by(case_id) %>%
    arrange(resp_rank) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      response_binary = case_when(
        response_recist %in% c("CR","PR") ~ "Responder (CR+PR)",
        response_recist %in% c("SD","PD") ~ "Non-responder (SD+PD)",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Cohort = cohort
    ) %>%
    select(case_id, Cohort, response_raw, response_recist, response_binary)

  cat("  n with response:", nrow(fu_clean), "\n")
  print(table(fu_clean$response_recist, useNA="ifany"))

  fu_clean
}

luad_resp <- build_response_table(luad_supp, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_resp <- build_response_table(lusc_supp, "TCGA-LUSC")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 4 — Build per-patient treatment type from drug supplement
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

build_tx_table <- function(supp, cohort) {

  drug <- supp$drug
  if (is.null(drug)) return(NULL)
  colnames(drug) <- tolower(colnames(drug))

  bc_col <- intersect(
    c("bcr_patient_barcode", "submitter_id", "case_id"),
    colnames(drug))[1]

  # therapy_types is the confirmed column from your script
  tx_col <- intersect(
    c("therapy_types", "therapy_type",
      "pharmaceutical_therapy_drug_name",
      "drug_name"),
    colnames(drug))[1]

  cat("\n[DRUG]", cohort,
      "| barcode:", bc_col, "| therapy col:", tx_col, "\n")

  if (is.na(tx_col)) return(NULL)

  drug %>%
    mutate(
      case_id    = toupper(substr(.data[[bc_col]], 1, 12)),
      tx_raw     = as.character(.data[[tx_col]]),
      tx_type    = case_when(
        grepl("chemo|platinum|paclitaxel|gemcitab|pemetrexed|vinorelbine|etoposide|docetaxel|carboplatin|cisplatin",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE) &
          !grepl("immun|checkpoint|pembrolizumab|nivolumab|atezolizumab|durvalumab|ipilimumab|bevacizumab",
                 tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "Chemotherapy",
        grepl("immun|checkpoint|pembrolizumab|nivolumab|atezolizumab|durvalumab|ipilimumab",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)   ~ "Immunotherapy",
        grepl("targeted|erlotinib|gefitinib|osimertinib|crizotinib|alectinib|bevacizumab|cetuximab|afatinib",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)   ~ "Targeted Therapy",
        grepl("radiat|radiation|XRT|SBRT|IMRT",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)   ~ "Radiation",
        !is.na(tx_raw)                   ~ "Other",
        TRUE                             ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Cohort = cohort
    ) %>%
    distinct(case_id, .keep_all=TRUE) %>%
    select(case_id, Cohort, tx_raw, tx_type)
}

luad_tx <- build_tx_table(luad_supp, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_tx <- build_tx_table(lusc_supp, "TCGA-LUSC")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 5 — Merge risk scores + response + treatment
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

luad_rs <- read.csv("TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
lusc_rs <- read.csv("TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

merge_all <- function(rs_df, resp_df, tx_df, cohort) {
  out <- rs_df %>%
    left_join(resp_df %>% select(case_id, response_recist, response_binary),
              by = "case_id") %>%
    left_join(tx_df   %>% select(case_id, tx_raw, tx_type),
              by = "case_id") %>%
    mutate(
      Cohort    = cohort,
      RiskGroup = factor(RiskGroup, levels = c("Low","High")),
      response_recist = factor(response_recist,
                               levels = c("CR","PR","SD","PD")),
      response_binary = factor(response_binary,
                               levels = c("Responder (CR+PR)",
                                          "Non-responder (SD+PD)"))
    )
  cat(sprintf("[MERGE] %s: n=%d | with response=%d | with tx=%d\n",
              cohort, nrow(out),
              sum(!is.na(out$response_recist)),
              sum(!is.na(out$tx_type))))
  out
}

luad_merged <- merge_all(luad_rs, luad_resp, luad_tx, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_merged <- merge_all(lusc_rs, lusc_resp, lusc_tx, "TCGA-LUSC")
pooled      <- bind_rows(luad_merged, lusc_merged) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = "LUAD+LUSC")

datasets <- list("TCGA-LUAD" = luad_merged,
                 "TCGA-LUSC" = lusc_merged,
                 "LUAD+LUSC" = pooled)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 6 — Colour palettes
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

RECIST_COLS <- c(
  "CR" = "#27AE60",
  "PR" = "#2ECC71",
  "SD" = "#F39C12",
  "PD" = "#E74C3C"
)
BINARY_COLS <- c(
  "Responder (CR+PR)"     = "#27AE60",
  "Non-responder (SD+PD)" = "#E74C3C"
)
TX_COLS <- c(
  "Chemotherapy"     = "#3498DB",
  "Immunotherapy"    = "#9B59B6",
  "Targeted Therapy" = "#E67E22",
  "Radiation"        = "#1ABC9C",
  "Other"            = "#95A5A6"
)
RISK_COLS <- c("Low" = "#1874CD", "High" = "#B22222")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 7A — Boxplot: Risk score by RECIST response (4 levels)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

plot_response_box <- function(df, group_col, group_levels,
                               col_vec, cohort_label, x_label,
                               min_n = 5) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]]),
           as.character(.data[[group_col]]) %in% group_levels) %>%
    mutate(GV = factor(as.character(.data[[group_col]]), levels = group_levels))

  # Drop groups with too few patients
  keep <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(GV) %>% summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    filter(n >= min_n) %>% pull(GV) %>% as.character()
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(GV %in% keep) %>%
    mutate(GV = factor(as.character(GV), levels=group_levels[group_levels %in% keep]))

  if (length(unique(plot_df$GV)) < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", cohort_label, x_label, "— <2 groups with n≥", min_n, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  n_grp <- length(unique(plot_df$GV))
  if (n_grp > 2) {
    gp  <- kruskal.test(RiskScore ~ GV, data=plot_df)$p.value
    gtx <- paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", formatC(gp, digits=3, format="g"))
  } else {
    gp  <- wilcox.test(RiskScore ~ GV, data=plot_df)$p.value
    gtx <- paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", formatC(gp, digits=3, format="g"))
  }

  ns    <- plot_df %>% group_by(GV) %>% summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop")
  xlabs <- setNames(paste0(ns$GV, "\n(n=", ns$n, ")"), as.character(ns$GV))
  pairs <- combn(levels(plot_df$GV), 2, simplify=FALSE)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x=GV, y=RiskScore, fill=GV)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, width=0.55, alpha=0.85, color="grey30") +
    geom_jitter(width=0.18, size=0.9, alpha=0.5, color="grey20") +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons   = pairs,
      method        = "wilcox.test",
      label         = "p.signif",
      tip.length    = 0.01,
      step.increase = 0.10,
      hide.ns       = TRUE
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(
      min(plot_df$RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE) - 0.5,
      max(plot_df$RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE) + 1.5
    )) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_vec, guide="none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels=xlabs) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cohort_label, "  —  Risk Score by ", x_label),
      subtitle = gtx,
      x        = x_label,
      y        = "3-miRNA Risk Score (z-scored)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size=11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color="grey40", size=10, face="italic"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size=10)
    )
}

cat("\n── Part 7A: Risk score by RECIST response ──\n")
for (dname in names(datasets)) {
  slug <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", dname)
  df   <- datasets[[dname]]

  # 4-level
  p4 <- plot_response_box(df, "response_recist",
                           c("CR","PR","SD","PD"), RECIST_COLS,
                           dname, "Primary Therapy Outcome (RECIST)")
  if (!is.null(p4))
    save_png(p4, paste0("RiskScore_RECIST_4level_", slug, ".png"))

  # Binary
  p2 <- plot_response_box(df, "response_binary",
                           c("Responder (CR+PR)","Non-responder (SD+PD)"),
                           BINARY_COLS, dname, "Treatment Response")
  if (!is.null(p2))
    save_png(p2, paste0("RiskScore_Response_Binary_", slug, ".png"),
             w=1600, h=1800)
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 7B — Boxplot: Risk score by treatment type
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n── Part 7B: Risk score by treatment type ──\n")
for (dname in names(datasets)) {
  slug <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", dname)
  df   <- datasets[[dname]]

  p <- plot_response_box(df, "tx_type",
                          c("Chemotherapy","Immunotherapy",
                            "Targeted Therapy","Radiation","Other"),
                          TX_COLS, dname, "Treatment Type")
  if (!is.null(p))
    save_png(p, paste0("RiskScore_TreatmentType_", slug, ".png"))
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 7C — Stacked bar: Response distribution within High/Low risk groups
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n── Part 7C: Response distribution by risk group ──\n")

make_stacked_bar <- function(df, cohort_label) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_recist), !is.na(RiskGroup)) %>%
    mutate(
      response_recist = factor(response_recist, levels=c("CR","PR","SD","PD")),
      RiskGroup       = factor(RiskGroup, levels=c("Low","High"))
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) < 10) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", cohort_label, "— n <10\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  # Chi-square test
  ct  <- tryCatch(chisq.test(table(plot_df$RiskGroup, plot_df$response_recist)),
                  error = function(e) list(p.value=NA))
  plb <- ifelse(is.na(ct$p.value), "Chi-sq p = NA",
                paste0("Chi-sq p = ", formatC(ct$p.value, digits=3, format="g")))

  prop_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(RiskGroup, response_recist) %>%
    summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(RiskGroup) %>%
    mutate(total=sum(n), pct=100*n/total,
           label=ifelse(pct>=6, paste0(round(pct,1),"%"), "")) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(prop_df, aes(x=RiskGroup, y=pct, fill=response_recist)) +
    geom_col(width=0.6, color="white", linewidth=0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label=label),
              position=position_stack(vjust=0.5),
              size=3.5, color="white", fontface="bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=RECIST_COLS, name="Response") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x) paste0(x,"%"),
                       expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0,105)) +
    labs(title    = paste0(cohort_label,
                           "  —  Response Distribution by Risk Group"),
         subtitle = plb,
         x = "Risk Group", y = "Proportion of Patients (%)") +
    theme_bw(base_size=11) +
    theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=12),
          plot.subtitle=element_text(color="grey40", size=10, face="italic"),
          panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x=element_blank())
}

for (dname in names(datasets)) {
  slug <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", dname)
  p    <- make_stacked_bar(datasets[[dname]], dname)
  if (!is.null(p))
    save_png(p, paste0("ResponseBar_byRiskGroup_", slug, ".png"),
             w=1600, h=1800)
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 7D — KM: Survival by RiskGroup × Response (4 curves)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n── Part 7D: KM by RiskGroup × Response ──\n")

km_risk_x_response <- function(df, cohort_label) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_binary), !is.na(RiskGroup),
           !is.na(os_months), !is.na(os_status)) %>%
    mutate(
      Joint = paste0(as.character(RiskGroup), " / ",
                     as.character(response_binary)),
      Joint = factor(Joint, levels=c(
        "Low / Responder (CR+PR)",
        "Low / Non-responder (SD+PD)",
        "High / Responder (CR+PR)",
        "High / Non-responder (SD+PD)"
      ))
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) < 10 || length(unique(na.omit(plot_df$Joint))) < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", cohort_label, "— insufficient data\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  cat(sprintf("  %s: n=%d | events=%d | groups=%d\n",
              cohort_label, nrow(plot_df),
              sum(plot_df$os_status), length(unique(plot_df$Joint))))

  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ Joint, data=plot_df)
  lr_p   <- 1 - pchisq(
    survdiff(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ Joint, data=plot_df)$chisq,
    df = length(unique(plot_df$Joint)) - 1
  )

  JOINT_COLS <- c(
    "Low / Responder (CR+PR)"       = "#27AE60",
    "Low / Non-responder (SD+PD)"   = "#A9DFBF",
    "High / Responder (CR+PR)"      = "#E74C3C",
    "High / Non-responder (SD+PD)"  = "#F1948A"
  )

  x_max <- min(ceiling(quantile(plot_df$os_months, 0.95)/12)*12, 120)
  brk   <- ifelse(x_max > 60, 24, 12)

  ns      <- plot_df %>% group_by(Joint) %>% summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop")
  leglabs <- paste0(ns$Joint, " (n=", ns$n, ")")

  km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
    km_fit, data=plot_df,
    palette           = JOINT_COLS[levels(plot_df$Joint)],
    size              = 0.85,
    pval              = FALSE,
    conf.int          = FALSE,
    risk.table        = TRUE,
    risk.table.height = 0.32,
    risk.table.fontsize = 2.8,
    risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
    tables.theme      = theme_cleantable(),
    censor.shape      = "|", censor.size=2.5,
    surv.median.line  = "hv",
    legend.labs       = leglabs,
    legend.title      = "",
    xlab  = "Time (months)",
    ylab  = "Overall Survival Probability",
    xlim  = c(0, x_max),
    break.time.by = brk,
    ylim  = c(0, 1.02),
    title = paste0(cohort_label,
                   " — OS by Risk Group × Primary Therapy Outcome"),
    ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size=10) +
      theme(
        plot.title      = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size=8, color="grey30"),
        legend.position = c(0.70, 0.75),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="grey80",
                                          linewidth=0.3),
        legend.text = element_text(size=7.5)
      )
  )
  km_plot$plot <- km_plot$plot +
    labs(subtitle = paste0("Log-rank p = ",
                           formatC(lr_p, digits=3, format="g")))

  slug <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", cohort_label)
  out  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0("KM_RiskGroup_x_Response_", slug, ".png"))
  png(out, width=2400, height=2400, res=300)
  print(km_plot)
  dev.off()
  cat("  Saved:", out, "\n")
}

for (dname in names(datasets)) {
  km_risk_x_response(datasets[[dname]], dname)
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 7E — Logistic regression: risk score predicts responder status
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n── Part 7E: Logistic regression ──\n")

logistic_rows <- lapply(names(datasets), function(dname) {
  df  <- datasets[[dname]]
  sub <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_binary), !is.na(RiskScore)) %>%
    mutate(Responder = as.integer(response_binary == "Responder (CR+PR)"))
  if (nrow(sub) < 10 || length(unique(sub$Responder)) < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", dname, "\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  fit <- glm(Responder ~ RiskScore, data=sub, family=binomial)
  s   <- summary(fit)
  or  <- exp(coef(fit)["RiskScore"])
  ci  <- exp(confint.default(fit)["RiskScore",])
  p   <- s$coefficients["RiskScore","Pr(>|z|)"]
  cat(sprintf("  %s: OR=%.3f (%.3f-%.3f) p=%s\n",
              dname, or, ci[1], ci[2],
              formatC(p, digits=3, format="g")))
  data.frame(Cohort=dname, n=nrow(sub), n_responders=sum(sub$Responder),
             OR=round(or,3), OR_lo=round(ci[1],3), OR_hi=round(ci[2],3),
             p_value=formatC(p, digits=3, format="g"))
}) %>% bind_rows()

if (nrow(logistic_rows) > 0) {
  write.csv(logistic_rows,
            file.path(OUT_DIR, "Logistic_RiskScore_predicts_Response.csv"),
            row.names=FALSE)
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 8 — Summary statistics CSV
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

summary_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(names(datasets), function(dname) {
  df <- datasets[[dname]]
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_recist)) %>%
    group_by(Response = as.character(response_recist)) %>%
    summarise(
      n               = n(),
      Median_RiskScore = round(median(RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
      Mean_RiskScore   = round(mean(RiskScore,   na.rm=TRUE), 4),
      SD_RiskScore     = round(sd(RiskScore,     na.rm=TRUE), 4),
      .groups          = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Cohort = dname)
}))

if (nrow(summary_tbl) > 0) {
  cat("\n═══ Risk Score by Response — Summary ═══\n")
  print(summary_tbl %>% select(Cohort, Response, n,
                                Median_RiskScore, Mean_RiskScore),
        row.names=FALSE)
  write.csv(summary_tbl,
            file.path(OUT_DIR, "RiskScore_vs_PrimaryResponse_summary.csv"),
            row.names=FALSE)
}

cat("\n✓ Done. All outputs in:", OUT_DIR, "\n")
cat("  RiskScore_RECIST_4level_*.png        — boxplot CR/PR/SD/PD\n")
cat("  RiskScore_Response_Binary_*.png      — boxplot Responder vs Non-responder\n")
cat("  RiskScore_TreatmentType_*.png        — boxplot by treatment type\n")
cat("  ResponseBar_byRiskGroup_*.png        — stacked bar High vs Low\n")
cat("  KM_RiskGroup_x_Response_*.png        — 4-curve KM\n")
cat("  RiskScore_vs_PrimaryResponse_summary.csv\n")
cat("  Logistic_RiskScore_predicts_Response.csv\n")
```


#Fix KM above 
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIX: KM Survival by RiskGroup × Primary Therapy Outcome
# Issue: ggsurvplot palette was a named vector → all curves rendered grey
# Fix:   palette must be an UNNAMED vector ordered by factor levels
#
# Drop-in replacement for Part 7D in RiskScore_vs_TreatmentResponse_TCGA_v2.R
# Assumes these objects already exist in your environment:
#   datasets       — list of merged data frames (LUAD, LUSC, pooled)
#   OUT_DIR        — output folder path
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(dplyr)

OUT_DIR <- "Output_TxResponse"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ── Fixed joint-level colours (order must match factor levels exactly) ────
JOINT_LEVELS <- c(
  "Low / Responder (CR+PR)",
  "Low / Non-responder (SD+PD)",
  "High / Responder (CR+PR)",
  "High / Non-responder (SD+PD)"
)

# Unnamed vector — position maps to factor level position
JOINT_PALETTE <- c(
  "#B4D3D9",   # Low  / Responder      → dark green
  "#9B8EC7",   # Low  / Non-responder  → light green
  "#F2D479",   # High / Responder      → dark red
  "#C44A3A"    # High / Non-responder  → light red
)

km_risk_x_response_fixed <- function(df, cohort_label) {

  # ── Build joint variable with fixed factor levels ─────────────────────
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(response_binary),
      !is.na(RiskGroup),
      !is.na(os_months),
      !is.na(os_status)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Joint = paste0(as.character(RiskGroup), " / ",
                     as.character(response_binary)),
      Joint = factor(Joint, levels = JOINT_LEVELS)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Joint))   # drop any combinations not in the 4 levels

  # ── Guard ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  n_groups <- length(unique(droplevels(plot_df$Joint)))
  if (nrow(plot_df) < 10 || n_groups < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", cohort_label,
        "— n =", nrow(plot_df), "| groups =", n_groups, "\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  cat(sprintf("\n[KM] %s: n=%d | events=%d | groups=%d\n",
              cohort_label, nrow(plot_df),
              sum(plot_df$os_status), n_groups))

  # ── Which of the 4 levels actually appear in the data? ───────────────
  present_levels <- JOINT_LEVELS[JOINT_LEVELS %in% unique(plot_df$Joint)]
  present_cols   <- JOINT_PALETTE[JOINT_LEVELS %in% unique(plot_df$Joint)]

  # Re-factor to only present levels so palette stays aligned
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(Joint = factor(as.character(Joint), levels = present_levels))

  # ── Survival model ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ Joint, data = plot_df)
  lr_obj <- survdiff(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ Joint, data = plot_df)
  lr_p   <- 1 - pchisq(lr_obj$chisq, df = n_groups - 1)

  # ── Axis settings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  x_max <- min(ceiling(quantile(plot_df$os_months, 0.95) / 12) * 12, 120)
  brk   <- ifelse(x_max > 60, 24, 12)

  # ── Legend labels with n per group ───────────────────────────────────
  ns      <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(Joint) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), events = sum(os_status), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(match(Joint, present_levels))

  leg_labs <- paste0(ns$Joint,
                     " (n=", ns$n,
                     ", ev=", ns$events, ")")

  # ── KM plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
    km_fit,
    data                = plot_df,

    # KEY FIX: pass the UNNAMED ordered colour vector, not a named one
    palette             = present_cols,

    size                = 0.9,
    linetype            = "solid",
    pval                = FALSE,
    conf.int            = FALSE,
    risk.table          = TRUE,
    risk.table.height   = 0.30,
    risk.table.fontsize = 3,
    risk.table.y.text   = FALSE,
    tables.theme        = theme_cleantable(),
    censor.shape        = "|",
    censor.size         = 3,
    surv.median.line    = "hv",
    legend.labs         = leg_labs,
    legend.title        = "",
    xlab                = "Time (months)",
    ylab                = "Overall Survival Probability",
    xlim                = c(0, x_max),
    break.time.by       = brk,
    ylim                = c(0, 1.02),
    title               = paste0(cohort_label,
                                 " — OS by Risk Group \u00d7 Primary Therapy Outcome"),
    ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30",
                                          margin = margin(b = 4)),
        legend.position   = c(0.72, 0.78),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill  = "white",
                                          color = "grey80",
                                          linewidth = 0.3),
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.minor  = element_blank()
      )
  )

  # Subtitle with log-rank p
  km_plot$plot <- km_plot$plot +
    labs(subtitle = paste0(
      "Log-rank p = ", formatC(lr_p, digits = 3, format = "g"),
      "   |   Low=blue tones  ·  High=red tones  ·  Dark=Responder"
    ))

  # ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  slug <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", cohort_label)
  out  <- file.path(OUT_DIR,
                    paste0("KM_RiskGroup_x_Response_", slug, ".png"))
  png(out, width = 3000, height = 2400, res = 300)
  print(km_plot)
  dev.off()
  cat("  Saved:", out, "\n")

  invisible(km_plot)
}

# ── Run for all three cohorts ─────────────────────────────────────────────
for (dname in names(datasets)) {
  km_risk_x_response_fixed(datasets[[dname]], dname)
}

cat("\n✓ Colour-fixed KM plots saved to", OUT_DIR, "\n")
cat("  Colour legend:\n")
cat("  Dark green  = Low risk  / Responder (CR+PR)\n")
cat("  Light green = Low risk  / Non-responder (SD+PD)\n")
cat("  Dark red    = High risk / Responder (CR+PR)\n")
cat("  Light red   = High risk / Non-responder (SD+PD)\n")
```

#risk score vs treatment response advance stage
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RISK SCORE vs PRIMARY THERAPY OUTCOME — STAGE III & IV ONLY
# Cohorts : TCGA-LUAD  |  TCGA-LUSC  |  Pooled
#
# Pipeline:
#   1. Load risk scores (from TCGA_validation_3miRNA script)
#   2. Attach stage from clinical supplement → filter to III + IV
#   3. Attach primary_therapy_outcome_success from follow_up supplement
#   4. Attach treatment type from drug supplement
#   5. Run all comparisons:
#        A. Boxplot — risk score by RECIST response (4-level & binary)
#        B. Boxplot — risk score by treatment type
#        C. Stacked bar — response distribution by risk group
#        D. KM — survival by risk group × response (4 curves)
#        E. Logistic regression — risk score predicts responder status
#
# Inputs  (must exist in working directory):
#   TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv
#   TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv
#   TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds          ← from GDCquery_clinic()
#   TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds
#   TCGA_LUAD_followup.rds          ← from GDCprepare_clinic("follow_up")
#   TCGA_LUSC_followup.rds
#   TCGA_LUAD_drug.rds              ← from GDCprepare_clinic("drug")
#   TCGA_LUSC_drug.rds
#
# If followup/drug RDS files don't exist yet, set
#   RUN_SUPPLEMENT_DOWNLOAD <- TRUE
#
# Outputs : Output_StageIII_IV_TxResponse/ folder
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(scales)

OUT_DIR <- "Output_StageIII_IV_TxResponse"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Stage filter — change here to adjust scope
STAGE_FILTER <- c("III", "IV")   # broad stage_group values

# Minimum group size to run statistics
MIN_N <- 10

RUN_SUPPLEMENT_DOWNLOAD <- FALSE  # TRUE only on first run


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Helper: save PNG
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

save_png <- function(p, filename, w = 2200, h = 2000) {
  path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, filename)
  png(path, width = w, height = h, res = 300)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  cat("  Saved:", path, "\n")
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 0 — Download clinical supplement if needed
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if (RUN_SUPPLEMENT_DOWNLOAD) {
  for (project in c("TCGA-LUAD", "TCGA-LUSC")) {
    prefix <- gsub("-", "_", project)
    cat("\nDownloading supplement for", project, "\n")
    q <- GDCquery(project       = project,
                  data.category = "Clinical",
                  data.type     = "Clinical Supplement",
                  data.format   = "BCR XML")
    GDCdownload(q, method = "api")

    fu   <- tryCatch(GDCprepare_clinic(q, clinical.info = "follow_up"),
                     error = function(e) { cat("  follow_up failed\n"); NULL })
    drug <- tryCatch(GDCprepare_clinic(q, clinical.info = "drug"),
                     error = function(e) { cat("  drug failed\n"); NULL })

    if (!is.null(fu))   saveRDS(fu,   paste0(prefix, "_followup.rds"))
    if (!is.null(drug)) saveRDS(drug, paste0(prefix, "_drug.rds"))
    cat("  Saved", prefix, "_followup.rds &", prefix, "_drug.rds\n")
  }
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 1 — Load all inputs
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n── Loading data ──\n")

luad_rs   <- read.csv("TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
lusc_rs   <- read.csv("TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
luad_clin <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_clinical.rds")
lusc_clin <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_clinical.rds")
luad_fu   <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_followup.rds")
lusc_fu   <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_followup.rds")
luad_drug <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_drug.rds")
lusc_drug <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_drug.rds")

cat("LUAD risk scores: n =", nrow(luad_rs), "\n")
cat("LUSC risk scores: n =", nrow(lusc_rs), "\n")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 2 — Stage annotation (broad I/II/III/IV)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

to_title_stage <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return(NA_character_)
    words <- strsplit(tolower(trimws(s)), "\\s+")[[1]]
    words <- sapply(words, function(w) {
      if (w %in% c("i","ia","ib","ii","iia","iib",
                   "iii","iiia","iiib","iv","iva","ivb"))
        toupper(w)
      else paste0(toupper(substr(w,1,1)), substr(w,2,nchar(w)))
    })
    paste(words, collapse = " ")
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

attach_stage <- function(rs_df, clin_df, cohort) {
  colnames(clin_df) <- tolower(colnames(clin_df))

  bc_col <- intersect(
    c("bcr_patient_barcode","submitter_id","case_id"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]

  stage_col <- intersect(
    c("ajcc_pathologic_stage","ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage",
      "tumor_stage","clinical_stage","pathologic_stage"),
    colnames(clin_df))[1]

  cat("\n[STAGE]", cohort, "| stage col:", stage_col, "\n")

  stage_df <- clin_df %>%
    mutate(
      case_id   = toupper(substr(.data[[bc_col]], 1, 12)),
      stage_raw = to_title_stage(.data[[stage_col]])
    ) %>%
    select(case_id, stage_raw) %>%
    distinct(case_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      stage_group = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I",  "Stage IA", "Stage IB")   ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II", "Stage IIA","Stage IIB")  ~ "II",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage III","Stage IIIA","Stage IIIB")~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV", "Stage IVA","Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      stage_fine = case_when(
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage I",  "Stage IA", "Stage IB")   ~ "I",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage II", "Stage IIA","Stage IIB")  ~ "II",
        stage_raw == "Stage IIIA"                               ~ "IIIA",
        stage_raw == "Stage IIIB"                               ~ "IIIB",
        stage_raw == "Stage III"                                ~ "III",
        stage_raw %in% c("Stage IV", "Stage IVA","Stage IVB")  ~ "IV",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  merged <- rs_df %>%
    left_join(stage_df %>% select(case_id, stage_group, stage_fine),
              by = "case_id")

  cat("  Stage distribution:\n")
  print(table(merged$stage_group, useNA = "ifany"))
  merged
}

luad_staged <- attach_stage(luad_rs, luad_clin, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_staged <- attach_stage(lusc_rs, lusc_clin, "TCGA-LUSC")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 3 — Filter to Stage III + IV
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

luad_adv <- luad_staged %>% filter(stage_group %in% STAGE_FILTER)
lusc_adv <- lusc_staged %>% filter(stage_group %in% STAGE_FILTER)

cat(sprintf("\n[FILTER] Stage %s only:\n", paste(STAGE_FILTER, collapse="+")))
cat(sprintf("  LUAD: %d → %d patients\n", nrow(luad_staged), nrow(luad_adv)))
cat(sprintf("  LUSC: %d → %d patients\n", nrow(lusc_staged), nrow(lusc_adv)))

# Recompute median-based RiskGroup WITHIN the stage-filtered subset
luad_adv <- luad_adv %>%
  mutate(RiskGroup = factor(
    ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE), "High", "Low"),
    levels = c("Low","High")
  ))
lusc_adv <- lusc_adv %>%
  mutate(RiskGroup = factor(
    ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE), "High", "Low"),
    levels = c("Low","High")
  ))

cat("\n  LUAD RiskGroup after stage filter:\n")
print(table(luad_adv$RiskGroup))
cat("  LUSC RiskGroup after stage filter:\n")
print(table(lusc_adv$RiskGroup))


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 4 — Attach primary therapy outcome from follow_up supplement
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

build_response <- function(fu_df, cohort) {
  colnames(fu_df) <- tolower(colnames(fu_df))

  bc_col <- intersect(
    c("bcr_patient_barcode","submitter_id","case_id"),
    colnames(fu_df))[1]

  resp_col <- intersect(
    c("primary_therapy_outcome_success",
      "measure_of_response",
      "treatment_best_response",
      "therapy_outcome_first_course"),
    colnames(fu_df))[1]

  cat("\n[RESPONSE]", cohort,
      "| barcode:", bc_col, "| response col:", resp_col, "\n")

  if (is.na(resp_col)) {
    cat("  ⚠ No response column found. Available columns:\n")
    cat(paste(colnames(fu_df), collapse=", "), "\n")
    return(tibble(case_id = character(),
                  response_recist = character(),
                  response_binary = character()))
  }

  out <- fu_df %>%
    mutate(
      case_id      = toupper(substr(.data[[bc_col]], 1, 12)),
      response_raw = as.character(.data[[resp_col]]),
      response_recist = case_when(
        grepl("complete remission|complete response|^CR$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "CR",
        grepl("partial remission|partial response|^PR$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "PR",
        grepl("stable|no change|^SD$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "SD",
        grepl("progress|^PD$",
              response_raw, ignore.case=TRUE) ~ "PD",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_recist)) %>%
    mutate(resp_rank = match(response_recist, c("CR","PR","SD","PD"))) %>%
    group_by(case_id) %>%
    arrange(resp_rank) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      response_binary = case_when(
        response_recist %in% c("CR","PR") ~ "Responder (CR+PR)",
        response_recist %in% c("SD","PD") ~ "Non-responder (SD+PD)",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    select(case_id, response_recist, response_binary)

  cat("  Response distribution:\n")
  print(table(out$response_recist, useNA="ifany"))
  out
}

luad_resp <- build_response(luad_fu, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_resp <- build_response(lusc_fu, "TCGA-LUSC")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 5 — Attach treatment type from drug supplement
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

build_tx_type <- function(drug_df, cohort) {
  colnames(drug_df) <- tolower(colnames(drug_df))

  bc_col <- intersect(
    c("bcr_patient_barcode","submitter_id","case_id"),
    colnames(drug_df))[1]

  tx_col <- intersect(
    c("therapy_types","therapy_type",
      "pharmaceutical_therapy_drug_name","drug_name"),
    colnames(drug_df))[1]

  cat("\n[TX TYPE]", cohort, "| tx col:", tx_col, "\n")
  if (is.na(tx_col)) return(tibble(case_id=character(), tx_type=character()))

  drug_df %>%
    mutate(
      case_id  = toupper(substr(.data[[bc_col]], 1, 12)),
      tx_raw   = as.character(.data[[tx_col]]),
      tx_type  = case_when(
        grepl("chemo|platinum|paclitaxel|gemcitab|pemetrexed|vinorelbine|etoposide|docetaxel|carboplatin|cisplatin",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE) &
          !grepl("immun|checkpoint|pembrolizumab|nivolumab|atezolizumab|durvalumab|ipilimumab",
                 tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)  ~ "Chemotherapy",
        grepl("immun|checkpoint|pembrolizumab|nivolumab|atezolizumab|durvalumab|ipilimumab",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)     ~ "Immunotherapy",
        grepl("erlotinib|gefitinib|osimertinib|crizotinib|alectinib|bevacizumab|cetuximab|afatinib|targeted",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)     ~ "Targeted Therapy",
        grepl("radiat|radiation|XRT|SBRT|IMRT",
              tx_raw, ignore.case=TRUE)     ~ "Radiation",
        !is.na(tx_raw)                     ~ "Other",
        TRUE                               ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(case_id, .keep_all=TRUE) %>%
    select(case_id, tx_raw, tx_type)
}

luad_tx <- build_tx_type(luad_drug, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_tx <- build_tx_type(lusc_drug, "TCGA-LUSC")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 6 — Merge everything
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

merge_final <- function(adv_df, resp_df, tx_df, cohort) {
  out <- adv_df %>%
    left_join(resp_df, by = "case_id") %>%
    left_join(tx_df %>% select(case_id, tx_type), by = "case_id") %>%
    mutate(
      Cohort          = cohort,
      response_recist = factor(response_recist, levels=c("CR","PR","SD","PD")),
      response_binary = factor(response_binary,
                               levels=c("Responder (CR+PR)",
                                        "Non-responder (SD+PD)")),
      tx_type         = factor(tx_type,
                               levels=c("Chemotherapy","Immunotherapy",
                                        "Targeted Therapy","Radiation","Other"))
    )

  cat(sprintf("\n[MERGE] %s Stage%s: n=%d | response=%d | tx_type=%d\n",
              cohort, paste(STAGE_FILTER, collapse="+"),
              nrow(out),
              sum(!is.na(out$response_recist)),
              sum(!is.na(out$tx_type))))
  out
}

luad_final  <- merge_final(luad_adv, luad_resp, luad_tx, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_final  <- merge_final(lusc_adv, lusc_resp, lusc_tx, "TCGA-LUSC")

pooled_final <- bind_rows(luad_final, lusc_final) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort    = "LUAD+LUSC",
    # Recompute risk group on pooled stage-filtered data
    RiskGroup = factor(
      ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE), "High", "Low"),
      levels = c("Low","High")
    )
  )

datasets <- list(
  "TCGA-LUAD" = luad_final,
  "TCGA-LUSC" = lusc_final,
  "LUAD+LUSC" = pooled_final
)

# Write filtered datasets for record
write.csv(luad_final,   file.path(OUT_DIR, "LUAD_StageIIIIV_risk_response.csv"),  row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(lusc_final,   file.path(OUT_DIR, "LUSC_StageIIIIV_risk_response.csv"),  row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(pooled_final, file.path(OUT_DIR, "Pooled_StageIIIIV_risk_response.csv"), row.names=FALSE)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 7 — Colour palettes
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

RECIST_COLS <- c(
  "CR" = "#27AE60", "PR" = "#2ECC71",
  "SD" = "#F39C12", "PD" = "#E74C3C"
)
BINARY_COLS <- c(
  "Responder (CR+PR)"     = "#27AE60",
  "Non-responder (SD+PD)" = "#E74C3C"
)
TX_COLS <- c(
  "Chemotherapy"     = "#3498DB",
  "Immunotherapy"    = "#9B59B6",
  "Targeted Therapy" = "#E67E22",
  "Radiation"        = "#1ABC9C",
  "Other"            = "#95A5A6"
)

# Joint KM colours — UNNAMED vector (position = factor level order)
JOINT_LEVELS  <- c("Low / Responder (CR+PR)", "Low / Non-responder (SD+PD)",
                   "High / Responder (CR+PR)", "High / Non-responder (SD+PD)")
JOINT_PALETTE <- c("#27AE60", "#A9DFBF", "#E74C3C", "#F1948A")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 8A — Boxplot: risk score by RECIST response
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

box_compare <- function(df, group_col, group_levels, col_vec,
                        cohort_label, x_label, min_n = 5) {

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]]),
           as.character(.data[[group_col]]) %in% group_levels) %>%
    mutate(GV = factor(as.character(.data[[group_col]]), levels=group_levels))

  keep <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(GV) %>% summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    filter(n >= min_n) %>% pull(GV) %>% as.character()

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(GV %in% keep) %>%
    mutate(GV = factor(as.character(GV),
                       levels=group_levels[group_levels %in% keep]))

  if (length(unique(plot_df$GV)) < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", cohort_label, x_label,
        "— <2 groups with n ≥", min_n, "\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  n_grp <- length(unique(plot_df$GV))
  if (n_grp > 2) {
    gp  <- kruskal.test(RiskScore ~ GV, data=plot_df)$p.value
    gtx <- paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", formatC(gp, digits=3, format="g"))
  } else {
    gp  <- wilcox.test(RiskScore ~ GV, data=plot_df)$p.value
    gtx <- paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", formatC(gp, digits=3, format="g"))
  }

  ns    <- plot_df %>% group_by(GV) %>% summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop")
  xlabs <- setNames(paste0(ns$GV, "\n(n=", ns$n, ")"), as.character(ns$GV))
  pairs <- combn(levels(plot_df$GV), 2, simplify=FALSE)

  stage_label <- paste0("Stage ", paste(STAGE_FILTER, collapse="+"))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x=GV, y=RiskScore, fill=GV)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, width=0.55, alpha=0.85, color="grey30") +
    geom_jitter(width=0.18, size=0.9, alpha=0.5, color="grey20") +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons   = pairs, method="wilcox.test",
      label         = "p.signif", tip.length=0.01,
      step.increase = 0.10, hide.ns=TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=col_vec, guide="none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels=xlabs) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cohort_label, " (", stage_label,
                        ")  —  Risk Score by ", x_label),
      subtitle = gtx,
      x = x_label,
      y = "3-miRNA Risk Score (z-scored)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size=11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color="grey40", size=10, face="italic"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size=10)
    )
}

cat("\n── Part 8A: Boxplots — risk score by response ──\n")
for (dname in names(datasets)) {
  slug <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", dname)
  df   <- datasets[[dname]]

  p4 <- box_compare(df, "response_recist", c("CR","PR","SD","PD"),
                    RECIST_COLS, dname, "Primary Therapy Outcome (RECIST)")
  if (!is.null(p4))
    save_png(p4, paste0("RiskScore_RECIST_4level_StageIIIIV_", slug, ".png"))

  p2 <- box_compare(df, "response_binary",
                    c("Responder (CR+PR)","Non-responder (SD+PD)"),
                    BINARY_COLS, dname, "Treatment Response")
  if (!is.null(p2))
    save_png(p2, paste0("RiskScore_Response_Binary_StageIIIIV_", slug, ".png"),
             w=1600, h=1800)
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 8B — Boxplot: risk score by treatment type
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n── Part 8B: Boxplots — risk score by treatment type ──\n")
for (dname in names(datasets)) {
  slug <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", dname)
  p    <- box_compare(datasets[[dname]], "tx_type",
                      c("Chemotherapy","Immunotherapy",
                        "Targeted Therapy","Radiation","Other"),
                      TX_COLS, dname, "Treatment Type")
  if (!is.null(p))
    save_png(p, paste0("RiskScore_TxType_StageIIIIV_", slug, ".png"))
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 8C — Stacked bar: response distribution by risk group
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n── Part 8C: Stacked bar — response by risk group ──\n")

make_stacked_bar <- function(df, cohort_label) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_recist), !is.na(RiskGroup)) %>%
    mutate(
      response_recist = factor(response_recist, levels=c("CR","PR","SD","PD")),
      RiskGroup       = factor(RiskGroup, levels=c("Low","High"))
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) < MIN_N) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", cohort_label, "— n <", MIN_N, "\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  ct  <- tryCatch(
    chisq.test(table(plot_df$RiskGroup, plot_df$response_recist)),
    error = function(e) list(p.value=NA)
  )
  plb <- ifelse(is.na(ct$p.value), "Chi-sq p = NA",
                paste0("Chi-sq p = ",
                       formatC(ct$p.value, digits=3, format="g")))

  prop_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(RiskGroup, response_recist) %>%
    summarise(n=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    group_by(RiskGroup) %>%
    mutate(total=sum(n), pct=100*n/total,
           label=ifelse(pct>=6, paste0(round(pct,1),"%"), "")) %>%
    ungroup()

  stage_label <- paste0("Stage ", paste(STAGE_FILTER, collapse="+"))

  ggplot(prop_df, aes(x=RiskGroup, y=pct, fill=response_recist)) +
    geom_col(width=0.6, color="white", linewidth=0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label=label),
              position=position_stack(vjust=0.5),
              size=3.5, color="white", fontface="bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=RECIST_COLS, name="Response") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x) paste0(x,"%"),
                       expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0,105)) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cohort_label, " (", stage_label,
                        ")  —  Response by Risk Group"),
      subtitle = plb,
      x = "Risk Group", y = "Proportion of Patients (%)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size=11) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face="bold", size=12),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(color="grey40", size=10, face="italic"),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )
}

for (dname in names(datasets)) {
  slug <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", dname)
  p    <- make_stacked_bar(datasets[[dname]], dname)
  if (!is.null(p))
    save_png(p, paste0("ResponseBar_byRiskGroup_StageIIIIV_", slug, ".png"),
             w=1600, h=1800)
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 8D — KM: survival by risk group × response (4 curves)
#           KEY FIX: palette = unnamed ordered vector (not named vector)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n── Part 8D: KM — risk group × response ──\n")

km_risk_x_response <- function(df, cohort_label) {

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_binary), !is.na(RiskGroup),
           !is.na(os_months), !is.na(os_status)) %>%
    mutate(
      Joint = paste0(as.character(RiskGroup), " / ",
                     as.character(response_binary)),
      Joint = factor(Joint, levels = JOINT_LEVELS)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Joint))

  n_groups <- length(unique(droplevels(plot_df$Joint)))
  if (nrow(plot_df) < MIN_N || n_groups < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", cohort_label,
        "n =", nrow(plot_df), "| groups =", n_groups, "\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  cat(sprintf("  %s: n=%d | events=%d | groups=%d\n",
              cohort_label, nrow(plot_df),
              sum(plot_df$os_status), n_groups))

  # Keep only present levels and align palette by position
  present_levels  <- JOINT_LEVELS[JOINT_LEVELS %in% unique(plot_df$Joint)]
  present_palette <- JOINT_PALETTE[JOINT_LEVELS %in% unique(plot_df$Joint)]

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(Joint = factor(as.character(Joint), levels=present_levels))

  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ Joint, data=plot_df)
  lr_p   <- 1 - pchisq(
    survdiff(Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ Joint, data=plot_df)$chisq,
    df = n_groups - 1
  )

  x_max <- min(ceiling(quantile(plot_df$os_months, 0.95)/12)*12, 120)
  brk   <- ifelse(x_max > 60, 24, 12)

  ns      <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(Joint) %>%
    summarise(n=n(), ev=sum(os_status), .groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(match(Joint, present_levels))
  leg_labs <- paste0(ns$Joint, " (n=", ns$n, ", ev=", ns$ev, ")")

  stage_label <- paste0("Stage ", paste(STAGE_FILTER, collapse="+"))

  km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
    km_fit, data=plot_df,
    palette             = present_palette,   # unnamed vector — KEY FIX
    size                = 0.9,
    pval                = FALSE,
    conf.int            = FALSE,
    risk.table          = TRUE,
    risk.table.height   = 0.30,
    risk.table.fontsize = 3,
    risk.table.y.text   = FALSE,
    tables.theme        = theme_cleantable(),
    censor.shape        = "|", censor.size=3,
    surv.median.line    = "hv",
    legend.labs         = leg_labs,
    legend.title        = "",
    xlab  = "Time (months)",
    ylab  = "Overall Survival Probability",
    xlim  = c(0, x_max),
    break.time.by = brk,
    ylim  = c(0, 1.02),
    title = paste0(cohort_label, " (", stage_label,
                   ") — OS by Risk Group \u00d7 Primary Therapy Outcome"),
    ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size=10) +
      theme(
        plot.title        = element_text(face="bold", size=11),
        plot.subtitle     = element_text(size=8, color="grey30"),
        legend.position   = c(0.70, 0.78),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="grey80",
                                          linewidth=0.3),
        legend.text       = element_text(size=7.5),
        panel.grid.minor  = element_blank()
      )
  )
  km_plot$plot <- km_plot$plot +
    labs(subtitle = paste0(
      "Log-rank p = ", formatC(lr_p, digits=3, format="g"),
      "   |   Dark=Responder  ·  Green=Low risk  ·  Red=High risk"
    ))

  slug <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", cohort_label)
  out  <- file.path(OUT_DIR,
                    paste0("KM_RiskGroup_x_Response_StageIIIIV_", slug, ".png"))
  png(out, width=2400, height=2400, res=300)
  print(km_plot)
  dev.off()
  cat("  Saved:", out, "\n")
}

for (dname in names(datasets)) {
  km_risk_x_response(datasets[[dname]], dname)
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 8E — Logistic regression: risk score predicts responder status
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n── Part 8E: Logistic regression ──\n")

logistic_rows <- bind_rows(lapply(names(datasets), function(dname) {
  df  <- datasets[[dname]]
  sub <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_binary), !is.na(RiskScore)) %>%
    mutate(Responder = as.integer(response_binary == "Responder (CR+PR)"))

  if (nrow(sub) < MIN_N || length(unique(sub$Responder)) < 2) {
    cat("  [SKIP]", dname, "— n =", nrow(sub), "\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  fit <- glm(Responder ~ RiskScore, data=sub, family=binomial)
  s   <- summary(fit)
  or  <- exp(coef(fit)["RiskScore"])
  ci  <- exp(confint.default(fit)["RiskScore",])
  p   <- s$coefficients["RiskScore","Pr(>|z|)"]

  cat(sprintf("  %s: OR=%.3f (%.3f-%.3f) p=%s\n",
              dname, or, ci[1], ci[2],
              formatC(p, digits=3, format="g")))

  data.frame(
    Cohort       = dname,
    Stage        = paste(STAGE_FILTER, collapse="+"),
    n            = nrow(sub),
    n_responders = sum(sub$Responder),
    OR           = round(or,   3),
    OR_lo95      = round(ci[1],3),
    OR_hi95      = round(ci[2],3),
    p_value      = formatC(p, digits=3, format="g")
  )
}))

if (!is.null(logistic_rows) && nrow(logistic_rows) > 0) {
  cat("\nLogistic regression summary:\n")
  print(logistic_rows, row.names=FALSE)
  write.csv(logistic_rows,
            file.path(OUT_DIR, "Logistic_RiskScore_Response_StageIIIIV.csv"),
            row.names=FALSE)
}


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 9 — Summary statistics CSV
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

summary_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(names(datasets), function(dname) {
  datasets[[dname]] %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_recist)) %>%
    group_by(Response = as.character(response_recist)) %>%
    summarise(
      n                = n(),
      Median_RiskScore = round(median(RiskScore, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
      Mean_RiskScore   = round(mean(RiskScore,   na.rm=TRUE), 4),
      SD_RiskScore     = round(sd(RiskScore,     na.rm=TRUE), 4),
      .groups          = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Cohort = dname,
           Stage  = paste(STAGE_FILTER, collapse="+"))
}))

if (nrow(summary_tbl) > 0) {
  cat("\n═══ Risk Score by Response — Stage III+IV Summary ═══\n")
  print(summary_tbl %>%
          select(Cohort, Stage, Response, n,
                 Median_RiskScore, Mean_RiskScore),
        row.names=FALSE)
  write.csv(summary_tbl,
            file.path(OUT_DIR, "RiskScore_vs_Response_StageIIIIV_summary.csv"),
            row.names=FALSE)
}
```
